question: How will the escalation of US punitive tariffs on Indian exports, specifically the 50% levies citing Russian oil procurement, impact India’s energy import strategy and the broader stability of Russian commodity trade flows through the remainder of 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-12

**Research question**
How will the escalation of US punitive tariffs on Indian exports, specifically the 50% levies citing Russian oil procurement, impact India’s energy import strategy and the broader stability of Russian commodity trade flows through the remainder of 2025?

## Answer

The August 6, 2025 order is scheduled to bring the combined US levy to 50% on Indian goods covered by both the reciprocal tariff and the additional oil-linked duty, effective August 27, 2025. Russian oil procurement is the trigger; the duty falls on goods entering the US, not on crude entering India. As of 2025-08-12, the base case through December 2025 is that Indian state refiners replace some Russian spot cargoes while private refiners retain Russian supply. For investors, the likelier effect is a change in cargo destinations and the price Russia receives, not a barrel-for-barrel loss of Russian exports. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1305487990) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=The%20four%20refiners%20regularly%20buy%20Russian%20oil%20on%20a,and%20are%20the%20biggest%20Russian%20oil%20buyers%20in%20India.)

## Evidence

The headline rate is not a verified rate for every Indian export. The earlier July 30, 2025 announcement described a 25% tariff and a prospective penalty; its stated start date was not the effective date of the combined levy. The later account ties the increment specifically to oil. The available material does not include the operative product schedule, and the account naming pharmaceutical and rare-earth exceptions flags that claim as unverified. Exact coverage for an exporter therefore requires checking its US tariff classification against both schedules. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1305487990)

The state refiners’ pause preceded the order. Reuters sources said Indian Oil, Hindustan Petroleum, Bharat Petroleum and Mangalore had stopped seeking Russian crude and turned to Middle Eastern and West African spot grades. That establishes a practical replacement route, but a pause in new bids is not a halt in deliveries already booked. The order could prolong the switch; it cannot explain its onset. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=India%2C%20the%20world%27s%20third-largest%20oil%20importer%2C%20is%20the%20biggest,did%20not%20immediately%20respond%20to%20Reuters%27%20requests%20for%20comment.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250731150702/https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/07/31/indian-state-refineries-halt-russian-oil-imports-after-trump-tariff-threats-a90050#:~:text=Other%20major%20state-owned%20refiners%20%E2%80%94%20Hindustan%20Petroleum%2C%20Bharat%20Petroleum,crude%20following%20the%20Kremlin%E2%80%99s%20invasion%20of%20Ukraine%20in%202022.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=The%20four%20refiners%20regularly%20buy%20Russian%20oil%20on%20a,and%20are%20the%20biggest%20Russian%20oil%20buyers%20in%20India.)

## Outlook

Private contract purchases, not state refining capacity, determine how far the switch can go. Russia supplied about 35% of India’s crude, and private refiners bought nearly 60% of Russian imports averaging 1.8 million barrels per day in the first half of 2025. Reliance’s purchase of Murban for October shows it can diversify, but does not show it cancelled a Russian cargo. With Reliance and Nayara on annual deals, continued contract deliveries alongside more varied spot buying are more plausible than a nationwide exit. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=Russia%20is%20the%20top%20supplier%20to%20India%2C%20responsible%20for,month%2C%20an%20unusual%20move%20by%20the%20refiner%2C%20traders%20said.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=The%20four%20refiners%20regularly%20buy%20Russian%20oil%20on%20a,and%20are%20the%20biggest%20Russian%20oil%20buyers%20in%20India.)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is a sustained cut by private as well as state refiners that other buyers cannot absorb. India is Russia’s largest seaborne crude customer, so even successful redirection could require a deeper discount, reducing receipts without reducing volume. Track Reliance and Nayara’s Russian cargo receipts alongside Russian loadings and deliveries by destination: falling Indian receipts offset by arrivals elsewhere support redirection; sustained private cuts, unsold cargoes and falling total Russian loadings support a volume loss. The available evidence records buying plans, not those outcomes, and cannot establish a comparable disruption across Russian commodities beyond crude. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=India%2C%20the%20world%27s%20third-largest%20oil%20importer%2C%20is%20the%20biggest,did%20not%20immediately%20respond%20to%20Reuters%27%20requests%20for%20comment.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=The%20four%20refiners%20regularly%20buy%20Russian%20oil%20on%20a,and%20are%20the%20biggest%20Russian%20oil%20buyers%20in%20India.)

## Sources

1. [India–United States relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1305487990), available by 2025-08-12.
2. [Indian state refiners pause Russian oil purchases, Reuters reports](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=The%20four%20refiners%20regularly%20buy%20Russian%20oil%20on%20a,and%20are%20the%20biggest%20Russian%20oil%20buyers%20in%20India.), available by 2025-08-02.
3. [Indian state refiners pause Russian oil purchases, Reuters reports](https://web.archive.org/web/20250802093359/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/indian-state-refiners-pause-russian-oil-purchases-reuters-reports.html#:~:text=India%2C%20the%20world%27s%20third-largest%20oil%20importer%2C%20is%20the%20biggest,did%20not%20immediately%20respond%20to%20Reuters%27%20requests%20for%20comment.), available by 2025-08-02.
4. [Indian State Refineries Halt Russian Oil Imports – Reuters - The Moscow Times](https://web.archive.org/web/20250731150702/https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/07/31/indian-state-refineries-halt-russian-oil-imports-after-trump-tariff-threats-a90050#:~:text=Other%20major%20state-owned%20refiners%20%E2%80%94%20Hindustan%20Petroleum%2C%20Bharat%20Petroleum,crude%20following%20the%20Kremlin%E2%80%99s%20invasion%20of%20Ukraine%20in%202022.), available by 2025-07-31.

question: How should investors interpret the divergence between Harris Associates L P’s recent 3.6% reduction in its 5.12% stake in Centene (CNC) and CEO Sarah London's repeated insider purchases? Does this institutional selling signal fundamental risks to Centene's managed care margins or a valuation-driven portfolio adjustment?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-28

**Research question**
How should investors interpret the divergence between Harris Associates L P’s recent 3.6% reduction in its 5.12% stake in Centene (CNC) and CEO Sarah London's repeated insider purchases? Does this institutional selling signal fundamental risks to Centene's managed care margins or a valuation-driven portfolio adjustment?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

Verifying the trim requires Harris’s Centene share counts on consecutive reporting dates. A relative reduction divides the decrease in shares by the starting share count; it is not a percentage-point drop in ownership. To identify the cited stake as the starting or ending one, divide each holding by Centene’s shares outstanding on the corresponding date. Those dates and counts are missing. A partial sale could reflect position sizing or a narrower discount to Harris’s estimate of intrinsic value. But an expectation of lower margins could itself reduce that estimate, and no Centene-specific valuation or trade rationale establishes either explanation. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287372641)

London’s role is documented; her transactions are not. Her SEC insider transaction filings are needed to check codes and footnotes for discretionary open-market purchases rather than grants or other equity transactions. Without dates, quantities and prices, neither repetition nor the amount of her own money committed can be verified, and the trades cannot be placed within Harris’s reporting period. If confirmed, repeated purchases of meaningful size would be modest evidence that London found Centene attractive at those prices, not that Medicaid rates had caught up with claims costs. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=Represents%20a%20non-GAAP%20financial%20measure.%20A%20full%20reconciliation%20of,expected%20to%20cover%2016%2C000%20individuals%20in%20the%20first%20year.)

Medicaid’s payment structure makes persistent margin pressure plausible, but the quarterly comparison does not establish underpayment. States pay a fixed monthly premium per member. If the members who remain after eligibility reviews need more care, claims consume more of that premium unless rates keep pace. Centene attributed the higher Medicaid benefits ratio chiefly to flu-like illness; it also noted that the year-earlier quarter largely preceded the rise in enrollee acuity that intensified in the second quarter of 2024. A lower Medicare ratio tied to Part D changes partly offset the Medicaid increase in the consolidated figure. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1285792536) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=For%20the%20first%20quarter%20of%202025%2C%20premium%20and%20service,related%20expenses%20and%20severance%20costs%20due%20to%20a%20restructuring.)

## Outlook

Base case: Medicaid cost pressure eases from its flu-affected level over the next few quarters. There was already an offset to medical costs at the company level: the adjusted administrative expense ratio fell from 8.7% to 7.9% year over year. On April 25, 2025, Centene raised full-year premium and service revenue guidance by $6.0 billion on Marketplace enrollment and Medicare retention, but only reiterated adjusted diluted earnings per share above $7.25. The expense improvement was realized; neither the revenue increase in the forecast nor the unchanged earnings outlook demonstrates a Medicaid margin recovery. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=For%20the%20first%20quarter%20of%202025%2C%20premium%20and%20service,related%20expenses%20and%20severance%20costs%20due%20to%20a%20restructuring.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=Increased%202025%20premium%20and%20service%20revenues%20guidance%20by%20%246.0,quarter%20results%20were%20as%20follows%3A%20Total%20revenues%20%28in%20millions%29) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=Represents%20a%20non-GAAP%20financial%20measure.%20A%20full%20reconciliation%20of,expected%20to%20cover%2016%2C000%20individuals%20in%20the%20first%20year.)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that state rates persistently lag the cost of caring for the remaining Medicaid members. Watch per-member medical costs against effective state payments and the Medicaid benefits ratio after flu season and as rate updates take effect. If costs keep outgrowing payments and the ratio stays elevated, the margin warning strengthens independently of the ownership reports. A falling ratio as that gap closes would favor the base case. Neither outcome would establish Harris’s motive if the reported trim is confirmed. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1285792536) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=For%20the%20first%20quarter%20of%202025%2C%20premium%20and%20service,related%20expenses%20and%20severance%20costs%20due%20to%20a%20restructuring.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=difficulty%20of%20predicting%20the%20timing%20or%20outcome%20of%20legal,given%2C%20April%2025%2C%202025%2C%20and%20will%20not%20be%20updated)

## Sources

1. [Harris Associates](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287372641), available by 2025-04-25.
2. [CENTENE CORPORATION REPORTS FIRST QUARTER 2025 RESULTS - Apr 25, 2025](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=Represents%20a%20non-GAAP%20financial%20measure.%20A%20full%20reconciliation%20of,expected%20to%20cover%2016%2C000%20individuals%20in%20the%20first%20year.), available by 2025-04-26.
3. [Medicaid](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1285792536), available by 2025-04-15.
4. [CENTENE CORPORATION REPORTS FIRST QUARTER 2025 RESULTS - Apr 25, 2025](https://web.archive.org/web/20250426194108/https://investors.centene.com/2025-04-25-CENTENE-CORPORATION-REPORTS-FIRST-QUARTER-2025-RESULTS#:~:text=For%20the%20first%20quarter%20of%202025%2C%20premium%20and%20service,related%20expenses%20and%20severance%20costs%20due%20to%20a%20restructuring.), available by 2025-04-26.

question: Given the UK regulator’s competition concerns and Norway’s extended review, how do the strategic synergies of SLB’s $8 billion vertical acquisition of ChampionX weigh against the risk of deal termination or structural divestitures required to secure final regulatory approval?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-07

**Research question**
Given the UK regulator’s competition concerns and Norway’s extended review, how do the strategic synergies of SLB’s $8 billion vertical acquisition of ChampionX weigh against the risk of deal termination or structural divestitures required to secure final regulatory approval?

## Answer

As of 2025-04-07, an SLB investor should discount, not fully credit, the $400 million annual pretax synergy target for the roughly $7.8 billion ChampionX acquisition. My base case is a close with the agreed US Synthetic sale: SLB would retain the main production-business rationale, but the evidence does not show that it would retain every dollar of projected savings and revenue gains. Norway’s extended review puts the timing and scope of the deal at risk; it is not a rejection. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012000621/https://www.chemanalyst.com/NewsAndDeals/NewsDetails/slb-gives-update-on-championx-acquisition-amid-doj-review-30265#:~:text=ChampionX%20CEO%20Soma%20Somasundaram%20expressed%20excitement%20about%20the%20acquisition%2C,confidence%20in%20the%20transaction%E2%80%99s%20value%20creation.%20Journalist%3A%20Gabreilla%20Figueroa) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250308001553/https://www.upstreamonline.com/finance/slb-s-7-8-billion-merger-faces-more-delays-after-new-inquiries-emerge/2-1-1784486#:~:text=SLB%E2%80%99s%20%247.8%20billion%20merger%20faces%20more%20delays%20after%20new,will%20pursue%20further%20investigations%20into%20SLB%E2%80%99s%20acquisition%20of%20ChampionX) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250304235437/https://investorcenter.slb.com/news-releases/news-release-details/slb-provides-update-planned-acquisition-championx-0#:~:text=In%20conjunction%20with%20the%20HSR%20review%2C%20SLB%20and%20ChampionX,accelerate%20the%20energy%20transition.%20Find%20out%20more%20at%20slb.com.)

## Evidence

Closing as originally signed would let SLB sell ChampionX’s production technologies through its international network and pursue cost savings across the full business. The target is an annual benefit to be reached within the first three years post-closing, not earnings available at closing. Nor would all of that benefit accrue to existing SLB holders: under the all-stock terms, ChampionX holders would own approximately 9% of the combined company. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012000621/https://www.chemanalyst.com/NewsAndDeals/NewsDetails/slb-gives-update-on-championx-acquisition-amid-doj-review-30265#:~:text=SLB%20anticipates%20completing%20the%20transaction%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter,SLB%E2%80%99s%20focus%20on%20the%20growing%20production%20and%20recovery%20segment.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012000621/https://www.chemanalyst.com/NewsAndDeals/NewsDetails/slb-gives-update-on-championx-acquisition-amid-doj-review-30265#:~:text=ChampionX%20CEO%20Soma%20Somasundaram%20expressed%20excitement%20about%20the%20acquisition%2C,confidence%20in%20the%20transaction%E2%80%99s%20value%20creation.%20Journalist%3A%20Gabreilla%20Figueroa)

The US Synthetic sale illustrates why a narrower deal need not lose its strategic core. SLB would keep its own MegaDiamond cutter business and could still distribute ChampionX’s retained production offerings, but it would forgo US Synthetic’s future earnings and any savings or sales gains that require owning both cutter businesses. Relative to closing as signed, net sale proceeds would offset some of the value surrendered; they are not recurring synergies. Without the sale price, the unit’s earnings or a breakdown of the synergy target, neither the net value difference nor a precise percentage haircut is defensible. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250304235437/https://investorcenter.slb.com/news-releases/news-release-details/slb-provides-update-planned-acquisition-championx-0#:~:text=In%20conjunction%20with%20the%20HSR%20review%2C%20SLB%20and%20ChampionX,accelerate%20the%20energy%20transition.%20Find%20out%20more%20at%20slb.com.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012000621/https://www.chemanalyst.com/NewsAndDeals/NewsDetails/slb-gives-update-on-championx-acquisition-amid-doj-review-30265#:~:text=SLB%20anticipates%20completing%20the%20transaction%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter,SLB%E2%80%99s%20focus%20on%20the%20growing%20production%20and%20recovery%20segment.)

## Outlook

Discount timing separately from lost synergies. SLB moved from a late-2024 or early-2025 closing window to the end of the first quarter or early in the second quarter of 2025 after Norway extended its assessment. A later close lowers the present value of the same post-closing gains without necessarily reducing their eventual annual level. The UK CMA can require a sale or block a merger, but the available UK evidence describes its powers, not a ChampionX-specific finding, affected product or required remedy. The US sale agreement is not evidence of UK or Norwegian clearance. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012000621/https://www.chemanalyst.com/NewsAndDeals/NewsDetails/slb-gives-update-on-championx-acquisition-amid-doj-review-30265#:~:text=SLB%20anticipates%20completing%20the%20transaction%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter,SLB%E2%80%99s%20focus%20on%20the%20growing%20production%20and%20recovery%20segment.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250304235437/https://investorcenter.slb.com/news-releases/news-release-details/slb-provides-update-planned-acquisition-championx-0#:~:text=In%20conjunction%20with%20the%20HSR%20review%2C%20SLB%20and%20ChampionX,accelerate%20the%20energy%20transition.%20Find%20out%20more%20at%20slb.com.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250319233438/https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/competition-and-markets-authority/about#:~:text=We%20help%20people%2C%20businesses%20and%20the%20UK%20economy%20by,individuals%20that%20take%20part%20in%20cartels%20or%20anti-competitive%20behaviour)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside alternative is a remedy that removes a production business SLB intended to sell internationally. That would weaken the revenue case more directly than selling US Synthetic; termination would eliminate merger synergies altogether and the closing-conditioned sale would not proceed under the agreed terms. A published demand for production assets or a prohibition would shift weight toward that downside. Final clearances limited to the cutter sale, followed by a synergy forecast for the retained businesses, would support reducing the discount. question: How does the significant insider accumulation by Director John W. Childs in early 2025 impact the risk-reward assessment for Biohaven (BHVN), specifically contrasting his million-dollar investment against troriluzole's history of clinical failures and its high-stakes Q3 2025 PDUFA date?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-23

**Research question**
How does the significant insider accumulation by Director John W. Childs in early 2025 impact the risk-reward assessment for Biohaven (BHVN), specifically contrasting his million-dollar investment against troriluzole's history of clinical failures and its high-stakes Q3 2025 PDUFA date?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-04-23, do not initiate or increase a Biohaven position on Director John W. Childs’s reported buying alone. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=NEW%20HAVEN%2C%20Conn.%2C%20Feb.%2011%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Biohaven,first%20treatment%20to%20patients%20and%20families%20suffering%20from%20SCA.%22)

## Evidence

The clinical case rests on slower functional decline, not on insider confidence. Biohaven reported a 50-70% slower rate of decline over 3 years against an external control. The analysis used prespecified endpoints, and the direction of benefit was consistent against a separate European cohort. Those features make the result more persuasive than a comparison chosen after seeing the data. They do not eliminate the possibility that treated and untreated patients differed in ways the matching procedure did not capture. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=The%20NDA%20submission%20was%20based%2C%20in%20part%2C%20on%20positive,compared%20to%20placebo%20over%2048%20weeks%20in%20Study%20BHV4157-206.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012060450/https://acnr.co.uk/spinocerebellar-ataxia-troriluzole-topline-results/#:~:text=Study%20BHV4157-206-RWE%20was%20designed%2C%20in%20discussion%20with%20the%20US,differences%20at%20years%201%2C%202%2C%20and%203%2C%20favoring%20troriluzole.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=Biohaven%27s%20troriluzole%20clinical%20development%20program%20in%20SCA%20collected%20data,symptom%20onset%2C%20genotype%2C%20and%20trinucleotide%20repeat%20length%20%28by%20genotype%29.)

The claimed history of clinical failures and the later positive result concern different tests. The available accounts do not document which earlier trials missed which primary endpoints. Biohaven cites placebo-controlled evidence of stabilization in a genotype subgroup and fewer falls across genotypes over 48 weeks. Neither finding establishes that the earlier trial met an overall functional primary endpoint. Conversely, an earlier miss would not by itself refute a longer-term effect; the difficulty is showing that the later difference reflects treatment rather than differences between cohorts. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=The%20NDA%20submission%20was%20based%2C%20in%20part%2C%20on%20positive,compared%20to%20placebo%20over%2048%20weeks%20in%20Study%20BHV4157-206.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012060450/https://acnr.co.uk/spinocerebellar-ataxia-troriluzole-topline-results/#:~:text=Study%20BHV4157-206-RWE%20was%20designed%2C%20in%20discussion%20with%20the%20US,differences%20at%20years%201%2C%202%2C%20and%203%2C%20favoring%20troriluzole.)

## Outlook

The base case for positioning is to wait: a decision is expected in the reported quarter, but the share price could fall sharply if FDA requires a controlled trial. The strongest case for buying before the decision is that FDA reviewed the analysis plan in advance, the benefit persisted across comparisons, and approval could open a market with no approved SCA treatment. Reviewing a plan is not endorsing its results, however. Without a current valuation or credible estimates of what BHVN would be worth after approval versus a setback, the evidence does not show that the upside compensates for that downside. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012060450/https://acnr.co.uk/spinocerebellar-ataxia-troriluzole-topline-results/#:~:text=Study%20BHV4157-206-RWE%20was%20designed%2C%20in%20discussion%20with%20the%20US,differences%20at%20years%201%2C%202%2C%20and%203%2C%20favoring%20troriluzole.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20241012060450/https://acnr.co.uk/spinocerebellar-ataxia-troriluzole-topline-results/#:~:text=Spinocerebellar%20ataxia%20is%20a%20group%20of%20dominantly%20inherited%20neurodegenerative,potential%20priority%20review%20timelines.%20Cannabis-based%20medicine%20for%20neurodegenerative%20diseases) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=NEW%20HAVEN%2C%20Conn.%2C%20Feb.%2011%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Biohaven,first%20treatment%20to%20patients%20and%20families%20suffering%20from%20SCA.%22)

## What would change the view

Use separate tests for the trade and the drug. A public ownership filing showing discretionary purchases, prices and resulting holdings would establish Childs’s exposure and allow comparison with his existing stake. To raise the approval assessment, look instead for a public FDA assessment finding the matched controls sufficiently comparable to support a treatment effect. A request for randomized confirmation would support the opposite view. Another insider purchase would settle neither clinical question. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=Biohaven%27s%20troriluzole%20clinical%20development%20program%20in%20SCA%20collected%20data,symptom%20onset%2C%20genotype%2C%20and%20trinucleotide%20repeat%20length%20%28by%20genotype%29.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250307162039/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/biohaven-announces-fda-acceptance-and-priority-review-of-troriluzole-new-drug-application-for-the-treatment-of-spinocerebellar-ataxia-302373056.html#:~:text=The%20NDA%20submission%20was%20based%2C%20in%20part%2C%20on%20positive,compared%20to%20placebo%20over%2048%20weeks%20in%20Study%20BHV4157-206.)

## Sources

question: Given Alstom’s recent multi-billion Euro contract wins in North America and France alongside its May 2025 €1bn capital raise, how effectively is the company balancing its deleveraging objectives with the execution risks inherent in its record order backlog and transition to new high-speed platforms?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-10-28

**Research question**
Given Alstom’s recent multi-billion Euro contract wins in North America and France alongside its May 2025 €1bn capital raise, how effectively is the company balancing its deleveraging objectives with the execution risks inherent in its record order backlog and transition to new high-speed platforms?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The financing evidence describes a 2024 plan for €1.75 billion of shares and bonds, not an announcement or closing of the equity transaction posited for the following May. Completed equity proceeds would lower net debt, all else equal, whether held as cash or used to repay borrowings. They would not be operating cash generation. Management reaffirmed its outlook, but the excerpts give no numerical deleveraging target against which to measure performance. They define free-cash-flow conversion without reporting a result; funds from operations explicitly precede working-capital movements. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1318951463) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Fiscal%20year%202025%2F26%20outlook%20and%20medium-term%20ambitions%20confirmed%2023,at%20%E2%82%AC92.3%20billion%2C%20providing%20strong%20visibility%20on%20future%20sales.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Free%20Cash%20Flow%20Conversion%20ratio%20is%20computed%20as%20Free,before%20Working%20Capital%20variations.%20Contract%20and%20Trade%20Working%20Capital)

Both headline awards postdate the June backlog snapshot. On July 7, 2025, Alstom announced a New York MTA notice of award for 316 commuter cars worth EUR 2 billion. The ceiling is 3.3 only if the MTA takes the full option for up to 242 more cars. On 22 October 2025, France’s SNCF Voyageurs approved 30 Avelia Horizon trains for Eurostar for close to 1.4 billion euros, with options for up to 20 more trains. Neither announcement establishes a cash receipt or provides a reconciliation to booked orders; adding the awards or unexercised options to June backlog would not give a verified current balance. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250806122629/http://www.railwaypro.com/wp/alstom-confirms-new-york-railcar-contract/#:~:text=%5B%20August%205%2C%202025%20%5D%20Chiltern%20Railways%20to%20introduce,continue%20to%20ensure%20that%20passengers%20board%20and%20disembark%20quickly.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20251027081918/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/10/eurostar-chooses-alstom-30-avelia-horizon-very-high-speed-trains#:~:text=The%20new%20Avelia%20Horizon%20trains%20will%20be%20operated%20by,Tunnel%20%E2%80%93%20a%20first%20for%20a%20double-deck%20high-speed%20train.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Fiscal%20year%202025%2F26%20outlook%20and%20medium-term%20ambitions%20confirmed%2023,at%20%E2%82%AC92.3%20billion%2C%20providing%20strong%20visibility%20on%20future%20sales.)

The June quarter shows why backlog is a better indicator of future sales than of debt repayment. Orders of €4.1 billion were below sales of €4.5 billion, a quarterly book-to-bill ratio of 0.9111. That measures order replenishment, not collection speed or contract profitability. The reported backlog is substantial, but the excerpt gives no historical series establishing an all-time record. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Fiscal%20year%202025%2F26%20outlook%20and%20medium-term%20ambitions%20confirmed%2023,at%20%E2%82%AC92.3%20billion%2C%20providing%20strong%20visibility%20on%20future%20sales.)

The high-speed risk is the interval between spending on trains and securing customer acceptance. Eurostar’s four-voltage Horizon must serve five national networks and the Channel Tunnel, with first deliveries scheduled for 2031. Amtrak’s separate Avelia Liberty program illustrates both sides: after thirteen failed simulations it cleared that testing hurdle, and the first five sets entered service on August 28, 2025. That is evidence Alstom can bring a new platform into service, not a prediction that Horizon will follow the same timetable. If acceptance slips after production spending begins, inventory can tie up cash and milestone payments can move out even while the order remains in backlog. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20251027081918/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/10/eurostar-chooses-alstom-30-avelia-horizon-very-high-speed-trains#:~:text=The%20new%20Avelia%20Horizon%20trains%20will%20be%20operated%20by,Tunnel%20%E2%80%93%20a%20first%20for%20a%20double-deck%20high-speed%20train.) [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1317220159)

## Outlook

Base case: expect gradual, uneven deleveraging rather than a step down in debt when contracts are announced. The strongest more favorable case is that repeat Horizon orders and customer advances fund production before delivery, allowing debt to fall well before Eurostar takes its trains. SNCF had already ordered the platform and exercised an earlier international option, which makes repeat-production benefits plausible. The new order’s payment schedule is not disclosed here, so an advance cannot be assumed. [7](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1318185200) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20251027081918/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/10/eurostar-chooses-alstom-30-avelia-horizon-very-high-speed-trains#:~:text=The%20new%20Avelia%20Horizon%20trains%20will%20be%20operated%20by,Tunnel%20%E2%80%93%20a%20first%20for%20a%20double-deck%20high-speed%20train.)

## What would change the view

At the next comparable results, look for a bridge from opening to closing net debt that separates equity proceeds and asset sales from free cash flow after working-capital movements. Sustained positive free cash flow accompanied by lower net debt and on-time acceptances would establish that execution is funding deleveraging. Rising inventory, deferred acceptances and cash outflows despite sales growth would point the other way. A debt decline explained only by financing or disposals would improve the balance sheet without resolving the execution question. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Free%20Cash%20Flow%20Conversion%20ratio%20is%20computed%20as%20Free,before%20Working%20Capital%20variations.%20Contract%20and%20Trade%20Working%20Capital) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Fiscal%20year%202025%2F26%20outlook%20and%20medium-term%20ambitions%20confirmed%2023,at%20%E2%82%AC92.3%20billion%2C%20providing%20strong%20visibility%20on%20future%20sales.) [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1318951463)

## Checked calculations

- C1. Divide (x) — 4.1 ÷ 4.5 ≈ 0.911111 [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251001103008/https://www.alstom.com/press-releases-news/2025/7/alstoms-first-quarter-202526-commercial-momentum-good-start-outlook-confirmed#:~:text=Fiscal%20year%202025%2F26%20outlook%20and%20medium-term%20ambitions%20confirmed%2023,at%20%E2%82%AC92.3%20billion%2C%20providing%20strong%20visibility%20on%20future%20sales.)
- C2. MTA award ceiling including options (EUR billion) — 2 + 1.3 = 3.3 [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250806122629/http://www.railwaypro.com/wp/alstom-confirms-new-york-railcar-contract/#:~:text=%5B%20August%205%2C%202025%20%5D%20Chiltern%20Railways%20to%20introduce,continue%20to%20ensure%20that%20passengers%20board%20and%20disembark%20quickly.)

question: Evaluating the operational and financial resilience of Marks and Spencer following the April 2025 cyber attack: How will the suspension of online orders and the subsequent valuation drop impact the company's turnaround trajectory and its FTSE 100 standing?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-06

**Research question**
Evaluating the operational and financial resilience of Marks and Spencer following the April 2025 cyber attack: How will the suspension of online orders and the subsequent valuation drop impact the company's turnaround trajectory and its FTSE 100 standing?

## Answer

As of 2025-05-06, the April online-order suspension is more likely to delay Marks & Spencer’s turnaround than to undermine it. The halt interrupted a channel generating roughly 3.8 million pounds a day, but stores remained open and the outage does not, by itself, invalidate the plan to replace costly legacy shops. The valuation drop reduces M&S’s cushion against peers, but the available evidence does not establish its post-incident rank or show that its FTSE 100 place is at risk in June. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=How%20much%20has%20this%20attack%20cost%20the%20companies%3F%20Since,a%20stream%20now%20halted%20due%20to%20the%20ongoing%20shutdown.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=April%2028%3A%20Some%20M%26S%20stores%20report%20empty%20shelves%20and,Metropolitan%20Police%20force%20confirms%20it%20is%20investigating%20the%20attack.) [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1288553060) [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1289053201)

## Evidence

The near-term sales exposure is substantial, but the online run rate is not a daily profit-loss estimate. Easter payment and collection problems preceded the 25 April order halt; orders were still paused in the latest report. Online accounts for about one-third of clothing and home sales, not of group sales. Some purchases may shift to shops or wait until the site reopens. Neither the share recovered nor the margin on sales permanently lost is known. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1288553060) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=British%20retail%20giant%20Marks%20%26%20Spencer%20%28M%26S%29%20and%20the,about%20the%20incident%2C%20its%20effect%20and%20where%20things%20stand.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=How%20much%20has%20this%20attack%20cost%20the%20companies%3F%20Since,a%20stream%20now%20halted%20due%20to%20the%20ongoing%20shutdown.)

The market reaction measures investors’ reassessment, not cash spent or the distance to index removal. M&S shares fell 6.5 percent, wiping more than 700 million pounds off its market value. June standing depends on full market value relative to other qualifying companies. Without a post-incident ranking, peer values near the review boundary and the applicable removal threshold, the fall alone establishes neither likely deletion nor assured retention. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=How%20much%20has%20this%20attack%20cost%20the%20companies%3F%20Since,a%20stream%20now%20halted%20due%20to%20the%20ongoing%20shutdown.) [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1289053201)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that fulfilment disruption costs M&S customers beyond the shutdown. Food shortages and warehouse staff being sent home show why open stores are only a partial fallback. The base case predicts that stock availability and clothing and home sales recover as online ordering resumes. Persistent shortages or weak sales after reopening would point to lasting damage rather than a delay. For index membership, the decisive warning would be a verified rank near or beyond the removal boundary at the June review, not another price fall in isolation. [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=What%20happened%20in%20the%20cyberattack%20on%20Harrods%20and%20Marks,and%20returns%20at%20M%26S%20food%20stores%20cannot%20be%20processed.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250505071131/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/harrods-ms-hit-by-cyberattack-what-happened-whos-behind-it#:~:text=April%2028%3A%20Some%20M%26S%20stores%20report%20empty%20shelves%20and,Metropolitan%20Police%20force%20confirms%20it%20is%20investigating%20the%20attack.) [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1289053201)

question: How do the regulatory filings for Mitapivat in Thalassemia and the significant Q4 2024 institutional accumulation by Jefferies and Commodore Capital reconcile with the wave of insider selling in June 2025 by CEO Brian Goff and CMO Sarah Gheuens regarding AGIO's risk-adjusted valuation?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-06-29

**Research question**
How do the regulatory filings for Mitapivat in Thalassemia and the significant Q4 2024 institutional accumulation by Jefferies and Commodore Capital reconcile with the wave of insider selling in June 2025 by CEO Brian Goff and CMO Sarah Gheuens regarding AGIO's risk-adjusted valuation?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The verified US milestone is narrower and older: on Feb. 17, 2022, Agios announced FDA approval of mitapivat for hemolytic anemia in adults with pyruvate kinase deficiency. That dated announcement outweighs the secondary account dating the event to April 2022. The EU approval reported for November 2022 likewise is not evidence of a thalassemia filing. Agios identifies thalassemia as an investigational program; the available passages do not confirm submission, acceptance for review or a decision deadline in that indication. That is a verification gap, not a finding that no filing occurred. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250218170708/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-announces-fda-approval-pyrukyndr-mitapivat-first-disease#:~:text=%E2%80%93%20Agios%20to%20Host%20Investor%20Webcast%20Tomorrow%20at%207%3A00,for%20these%20patients%20that%20addresses%20a%20significant%20unmet%20need.%E2%80%9D) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1222216484) [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1292965691) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20240725031241/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-appoints-brian-goff-chief-executive-officer#:~:text=Conference%20Call%20Information%20Agios%20will%20host%20a%20virtual%20investor,more%20information%2C%20please%20visit%20the%20company%E2%80%99s%20website%20at%20www.agios.com.)

The institutional record contains a filing index and a table heading, not AGIO position rows for either manager. Verification requires matching each manager’s AGIO common-share count at quarter-end to its preceding quarter, rather than comparing market values that can rise with the stock price. Even a confirmed increase would establish a larger reported position at a past date, not the manager’s motive, current exposure or forecast for thalassemia. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250325183323/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095012324011775/0000950123-24-011775-index.htm#:~:text=Complete%20submission%20text%20file%20EIN.%3A%20470813844%20%7C%20State%20of,Fire%2C%20Marine%20%26%20Casualty%20Insurance%20%28CF%20Office%3A%2002%20Finance%29) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250325183323/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095012324011775/0000950123-24-011775-index.htm#:~:text=Seq%20Description%20Document%20Type%20Size%20INFORMATION%20TABLE%20FOR%20FORM%2013F) [7](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657)

The succession announcement supports Goff’s appointment, not a sale by him or Gheuens. No insider transaction report is supplied for either executive. To distinguish a discretionary reduction from a planned sale or tax withholding, check each ownership filing’s transaction code, date, shares, price, remaining stake and plan footnotes. A large discretionary reduction would warrant closer scrutiny than routine withholding, but neither establishes what the FDA will decide. [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20240725031241/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-appoints-brian-goff-chief-executive-officer#:~:text=Dr.%20Fouse%20joined%20Agios%20as%20a%20member%20of%20the,the%20role%20of%20chair%20of%20the%20board%20of%20directors.%E2%80%9D) [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20240725031241/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-appoints-brian-goff-chief-executive-officer#:~:text=Cautionary%20Note%20Regarding%20Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains,any%20product%20candidates%20it%20is%20developing%3B%20Agios%E2%80%99%20ability%20to)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative to retaining value is a raise if the model assumes a later launch than an accepted thalassemia application and a documented review date would support. Test timing against the regulator’s notice; test approval odds separately against indication-specific efficacy and safety, not the PK-deficiency trials. A delay or a narrower eligible population would argue for a cut. After approval, paid patient starts, persistence and realized net price would test the cash-flow forecast more directly than either group’s trades. [10](https://web.archive.org/web/20250218170708/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-announces-fda-approval-pyrukyndr-mitapivat-first-disease#:~:text=Agios%20is%20offering%20a%20robust%20set%20of%20access%20programs,transfused%20and%20regularly%20transfused%20adults%20with%20PK%20deficiency%2C%20respectively.) [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20240725031241/https://investor.agios.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agios-appoints-brian-goff-chief-executive-officer#:~:text=Cautionary%20Note%20Regarding%20Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains,any%20product%20candidates%20it%20is%20developing%3B%20Agios%E2%80%99%20ability%20to)

## Sources

question: Given the aggressive international expansion of Omnipod 5 and its expanded compatibility with Abbott and Dexcom sensors, how should investors interpret the divergence between the recent bullish analyst price target revisions (up to $380) and the significant Q2 2025 share liquidations by institutional leaders and corporate insiders?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-06-05

**Research question**
Given the aggressive international expansion of Omnipod 5 and its expanded compatibility with Abbott and Dexcom sensors, how should investors interpret the divergence between the recent bullish analyst price target revisions (up to $380) and the significant Q2 2025 share liquidations by institutional leaders and corporate insiders?

## Answer

Hold Insulet as of 2025-06-05. The bullish analyst target and significant Q2 2025 sales by leading institutional holders and Insulet insiders are unverified question premises. No analyst, selling manager or insider is identified in the available evidence, and no sale size is documented. Early Omnipod results therefore do not establish that the reported target is justified, but neither is there verified selling to warrant a trim. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657)

## Evidence

A filing published during the quarter need not describe trading during the quarter. The quarter was still open at the cutoff, and Form 13F reports quarter-end positions rather than dated transactions. Comparing a named manager’s share counts across filings could establish a net reduction in its disclosed position, not the timing or motive of a sale. An insider-sale claim needs separate transaction evidence identifying the person, date and amount; none is supplied. That leaves selling unverified, not disproved. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657)

## Outlook

The hold case turns on conversion, not reach. If the international rollout and Abbott and Dexcom compatibility described in the question expand access, the first useful test is whether more eligible patients start using Omnipod; the next is whether they reorder pods at attractive margins. The available material concerns manager exposures, not patient starts, repeat use, margins or the analyst’s valuation assumptions. It cannot show how much profitable adoption the target requires or whether early results are on that path. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657)

## What would change the view

The strongest buy case is that broader sensor choice removes a meaningful barrier to adoption. Sustained gains in starts and repeat orders in newly served markets, with margins holding up, would support a buy if a valuation using those results still offered upside to the market price. Weak repeat use despite wider access would favor a trim. Verified sales would merit scrutiny, but even confirmed reductions in fund holdings would be weaker evidence against the product thesis than disappointing patient retention. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657)

## Sources

1. [Form 13F](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1223018657), available by 2024-05-09.

question: Following British American Tobacco's (BTI) pivot from a fiscal loss to a £3.18 billion profit in 2024, how do significant Q4 2024 and Q1 2025 institutional inflows from FMR and Capital International, alongside the UBS upgrade, reflect a valuation of BTI's combustible-to-smokeless revenue transition?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-21

**Research question**
Following British American Tobacco's (BTI) pivot from a fiscal loss to a £3.18 billion profit in 2024, how do significant Q4 2024 and Q1 2025 institutional inflows from FMR and Capital International, alongside the UBS upgrade, reflect a valuation of BTI's combustible-to-smokeless revenue transition?

## Answer

As of 2025-05-21, I would value BTI primarily on the cash it can return from a still predominantly combustible business, while giving smokeless credit for improving profitability. I would not raise the smokeless valuation on the strength of FMR’s and Capital International’s reported inflows across Q4 2024 and Q1 2025 or the reported UBS upgrade. Their scale and rationale are unverified question premises. The measurable contrast is between £7,901 million of group free cash flow and a growing smokeless business that still accounts for only 17.5% of group revenue. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=while%20we%20expect%20significant%20regulatory%20and%20fiscal%20headwinds%20in,%25%20of%20total%20revenue%20%28%25%29%2017.5%25%20%2B1.0%20ppts%20Profit) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250309230824/https://www.bat.com/media/press-releases/_2025/february/preliminary-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2024#:~:text=We%20are%20making%20good%20progress%20and%20while%20there%20is,and%20Belarus%20in%20September%202023%20and%20translational%20FX%20headwinds)

## Evidence

Neither manager’s change in holdings can be measured from the available filing indexes: they identify information tables but show no manager-specific BTI share counts for comparison. Even a verified increase in depositary shares would establish greater exposure to BAT as a whole, not a purchase price or a valuation for smokeless. Nor is there a UBS note here identifying which earnings forecasts or valuation assumptions changed. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250516012229/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095012325005701/0000950123-25-005701-index.htm#:~:text=Seq%20Description%20Document%20Type%20Size%20INFORMATION%20TABLE%20FOR%20FORM%2013F%20Complete%20submission%20text%20file) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250102171828/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000095012324008740/0000950123-24-008740-index.htm#:~:text=Seq%20Description%20Document%20Type%20Size%20INFORMATION%20TABLE%20FOR%20FORM%2013F%20Complete%20submission%20text%20file) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=Other%20Information%20Continued%20Corporate%20information%20British%20American%20Tobacco%20p.l.c.,6LS%2C%20UK%20tel%3A%20%2B44%2020%207511%207797%20e-mail%20enquiries%3A)

The fiscal-profit figure in the question is an unverified premise, not the operating-profit measure BAT reports. Operating profit reached £2,736m in 2024 after a loss of £15,751m in 2023. The comparison is dominated by the prior year’s largely US impairment charges, even with a £6.2 billion Canadian settlement provision in the later year. Adjusted organic operating profit grew only 1.4% at constant rates. The return to reported profit is therefore weak evidence of a step change in recurring smokeless earnings. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=while%20we%20expect%20significant%20regulatory%20and%20fiscal%20headwinds%20in,%25%20of%20total%20revenue%20%28%25%29%2017.5%25%20%2B1.0%20ppts%20Profit) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250221085943/https://www.tobaccojournal.com/news/bat-posts-preliminary-year-end-results-2/#:~:text=British%20American%20Tobacco%20has%20posted%20its%20preliminary%20results%20for,said%20Tadeu%20Marroco%2C%20Chief%20Executive.%20%E2%80%9COur%20focus%20on%20Quality)

The strongest case for a higher smokeless valuation is that growth is already translating into contribution, not just replacing lost cigarette sales. New Categories revenue rose 8.9% organically at constant rates; contribution increased by £251 million on an adjusted organic, constant-currency basis, and contribution margin reached 7.1%. That is better evidence for the transition than the headline profit rebound. But New Categories excludes Traditional Oral, so its growth and margin should not be applied to all smokeless revenue; contribution is not free cash flow. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=while%20we%20expect%20significant%20regulatory%20and%20fiscal%20headwinds%20in,%25%20of%20total%20revenue%20%28%25%29%2017.5%25%20%2B1.0%20ppts%20Profit) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=Markets%20Those%20markets%20not%20defined%20as%20Developed%20Markets.%20Factory,nicotine%20products.%20THP%20Tobacco%20Heated%20Products%20%28i.e.%2C%20the%20consumables)

## Outlook

The base case depends on cigarette pricing continuing to offset volume declines while smokeless scales. Combustibles’ organic price/mix of +5.3% offset 5.2% lower volume, leaving organic revenue up just 0.1% at constant rates. That resilience and the planned £900 million buyback offer a reason to own the shares without paying a higher smokeless multiple. The cash flow is disclosed at group level, however; the precise combustible contribution cannot be isolated. Regulatory and fiscal pressure in Bangladesh and Australia makes the pricing offset worth monitoring. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=while%20we%20expect%20significant%20regulatory%20and%20fiscal%20headwinds%20in,%25%20of%20total%20revenue%20%28%25%29%2017.5%25%20%2B1.0%20ppts%20Profit) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250309230824/https://www.bat.com/media/press-releases/_2025/february/preliminary-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2024#:~:text=We%20are%20making%20good%20progress%20and%20while%20there%20is,and%20Belarus%20in%20September%202023%20and%20translational%20FX%20headwinds)

## What would change the view

I would raise the smokeless valuation if subsequent results show sustained New Categories margin gains and rising cash generation attributable to smokeless, particularly if combustible pricing no longer covers volume losses. Meeting BAT’s 2026 group growth targets alone would not distinguish those drivers. Comparable quarter-end holdings would test the reported position changes; an explicit UBS segment valuation or manager commentary would separately test whether the investment thesis was smokeless rather than cash returns. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250214225130/https://www.bat.com/content/dam/batcom/global/main-nav/investors-and-reporting/results-centre/pdf/FY_2024_Announcement.pdf#:~:text=while%20we%20expect%20significant%20regulatory%20and%20fiscal%20headwinds%20in,%25%20of%20total%20revenue%20%28%25%29%2017.5%25%20%2B1.0%20ppts%20Profit) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250309230824/https://www.bat.com/media/press-releases/_2025/february/preliminary-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2024#:~:text=We%20are%20making%20good%20progress%20and%20while%20there%20is,and%20Belarus%20in%20September%202023%20and%20translational%20FX%20headwinds)

question: What is driving the divergence between significant institutional accumulation by firms like Corvex and Southeastern and the widespread downward revisions in price targets by analysts at JPMorgan, Barclays, and Benchmark following IAC's reported $2.80 per share quarterly loss?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-06-05

**Research question**
What is driving the divergence between significant institutional accumulation by firms like Corvex and Southeastern and the widespread downward revisions in price targets by analysts at JPMorgan, Barclays, and Benchmark following IAC's reported $2.80 per share quarterly loss?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-06-05, the evidence does not establish that Corvex or Southeastern increased its IAC share count in the quarter at issue. Neither the size of either change nor the size and timing of the target cuts attributed to JPMorgan, Barclays and Benchmark can be verified. The apparent divergence is therefore unproven. One material reason to question the comparison is that Angi became independent of IAC; a lower target for IAC without Angi need not mean a lower valuation of the remaining businesses. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250525070317/https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANGI/profile/#:~:text=Chief%20Customer%20Officer%20%26%20Director%20Angi%20Inc.%20connects%20home,UTC%20-%20August%208%2C%202025%20at%2012%3A00%20PM%20UTC) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1291502709)

## Evidence

The holdings test is to compare each manager’s IAC shares at the start and end of the same quarter, not to treat the disclosure date as a purchase date. Neither pair of counts is supplied. For Southeastern, the comparison must also cover the same accounts: a Longleaf fund is only part of the manager’s portfolio. Even a verified net increase would not, by itself, show that the manager bought after the earnings report. [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1291502709)

## Outlook

The base case to test is a change in what the targets include, not an earnings-driven markdown. Angi was independent as of March 31, 2025. For each bank, compare its revised IAC target with its prior target after removing any per-share value it previously assigned to Angi. If the targets then broadly match, the cut is consistent with the separation. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250525070317/https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANGI/profile/#:~:text=Chief%20Customer%20Officer%20%26%20Director%20Angi%20Inc.%20connects%20home,UTC%20-%20August%208%2C%202025%20at%2012%3A00%20PM%20UTC)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is genuine disagreement about the remaining IAC businesses. The signal would be comparable filings showing net share additions alongside analyst notes that lower earnings forecasts or valuation multiples for those same businesses. A note tying that reduction to the quarterly result would support loss attribution; dated trades or manager commentary would be needed to call the buying a response to it. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250525070317/https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANGI/profile/#:~:text=Chief%20Customer%20Officer%20%26%20Director%20Angi%20Inc.%20connects%20home,UTC%20-%20August%208%2C%202025%20at%2012%3A00%20PM%20UTC) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1291502709)

## Sources

1. [Angi Inc. (ANGI) Company Profile & Facts - Yahoo Finance](https://web.archive.org/web/20250525070317/https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANGI/profile/#:~:text=Chief%20Customer%20Officer%20%26%20Director%20Angi%20Inc.%20connects%20home,UTC%20-%20August%208%2C%202025%20at%2012%3A00%20PM%20UTC), available by 2025-05-25.
2. [Southeastern Asset Management](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1291502709), available by 2025-05-21.

question: How should institutional investors reconcile ZTO's strong Q4 2024 revenue growth and earnings with the significant price target cuts from Citigroup, JP Morgan, and BofA in May 2025, considering the lowered 2024 parcel volume guidance and ongoing weakness in its freight forwarding unit?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-06-25

**Research question**
How should institutional investors reconcile ZTO's strong Q4 2024 revenue growth and earnings with the significant price target cuts from Citigroup, JP Morgan, and BofA in May 2025, considering the lowered 2024 parcel volume guidance and ongoing weakness in its freight forwarding unit?

## Answer

Hold existing ZTO positions as of 2025-06-25. The strong Q4 2024 revenue growth and earnings and the significant May 2025 target cuts by Citigroup, JP Morgan and BofA are unverified question premises. The available evidence establishes neither the size of the cuts nor the upside or downside from the cutoff share price. It documents earlier share offerings, not a current valuation. A strong quarter alone is not a reason to add, and a lower target alone is not a reason to trim. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215175120/https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/2040822/chinas-zto-express-looks-race-past-major-rivals-countrys#:~:text=Shares%20of%20the%20Shanghai-based%20company%20began%20changing%20hands%20at,embark%20on%20reverse%20mergers%20to%20gain%20a%20listing%20status.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215181458/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-09-22/zto-express-is-said-to-guide-hong-kong-listing-price-at-hk-218?embedded-checkout=true#:~:text=Chinese%20courier%20service%20giant%20ZTO%20Express%20Cayman%20Inc.%20and,Monday%20in%20New%20York%20amid%20a%20broad%20equity%20selloff.)

## Evidence

The lowered 2024 parcel-volume guidance and continuing freight-forwarding weakness are also unverified question premises. A cut to a full-year volume forecast is relative to an earlier forecast; it need not mean parcels declined year over year. Nor does consolidated quarterly revenue measure parcel count or forwarding profit. ZTO historically planned to expand its network to meet demand, which makes capacity utilization worth testing: fewer parcels than planned could leave more network cost per parcel. Actual volume versus plan, parcel revenue and cost per parcel, and forwarding’s contribution to operating profit are needed to tell whether either concern materially offsets the quarter’s earnings. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215175120/https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/2040822/chinas-zto-express-looks-race-past-major-rivals-countrys#:~:text=ZTO%20will%20use%20the%20IPO%20proceeds%20to%20buy%20land%2C,as%20e-commerce%20drastically%20changes%20people%E2%80%99s%20lifestyle%20and%20consumption%20habits.)

## Outlook

The base case for holding is that the reported quarter, if confirmed, supports earnings in that period but does not yet justify paying a higher multiple for future earnings. For each bank, compare its pre-cut and post-cut forward earnings per share on the same forecast horizon and accounting basis, then compare target price divided by those earnings. Lower earnings at a stable multiple would point to an earnings revision; check the margin forecast before attributing it to margin pressure. Stable earnings at a lower multiple would instead point to a valuation reset. Both can occur. The bank models are absent, and the historical Hong Kong offering discount cannot distinguish these explanations. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215181458/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-09-22/zto-express-is-said-to-guide-hong-kong-listing-price-at-hk-218?embedded-checkout=true#:~:text=Chinese%20courier%20service%20giant%20ZTO%20Express%20Cayman%20Inc.%20and,Monday%20in%20New%20York%20amid%20a%20broad%20equity%20selloff.)

## What would change the view

The strongest case for trimming is that weaker network utilization compresses parcel margins while forwarding losses or lower forwarding profits deepen the earnings shortfall, leaving the shares expensive even after the target cuts. Trim if subsequent segment results show that deterioration and the traded price still requires a margin recovery. Conversely, add if parcel profit per parcel holds up, the forwarding drag proves immaterial to consolidated profit, and the price offers upside on those earnings without a higher multiple. Historical reporting identifies competing couriers, but it does not establish current pricing pressure; realized unit margins are the better signal. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215175120/https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/2040822/chinas-zto-express-looks-race-past-major-rivals-countrys#:~:text=The%20delivery%20service%20bucked%20the%20trend%20of%20seeking%20a,as%20e-commerce%20drastically%20changes%20people%E2%80%99s%20lifestyle%20and%20consumption%20habits.)

## Sources

1. [Exclusive | ZTO Express drops in New York trading debut, weighed down by a declining market | South China Morning Post](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215175120/https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/2040822/chinas-zto-express-looks-race-past-major-rivals-countrys#:~:text=Shares%20of%20the%20Shanghai-based%20company%20began%20changing%20hands%20at,embark%20on%20reverse%20mergers%20to%20gain%20a%20listing%20status.), available by 2024-12-15.
2. [ZTO Express Raises $1.27 Billion in Hong Kong Listing - Bloomberg](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215181458/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-09-22/zto-express-is-said-to-guide-hong-kong-listing-price-at-hk-218?embedded-checkout=true#:~:text=Chinese%20courier%20service%20giant%20ZTO%20Express%20Cayman%20Inc.%20and,Monday%20in%20New%20York%20amid%20a%20broad%20equity%20selloff.), available by 2024-12-15.

question: How is the dual pressure of EU MiCA compliance-driven delistings by major exchanges and the emergence of institutional-backed competitors like Ripple’s RLUSD affecting Tether’s (USDT) global liquidity profile and its role as the primary settlement asset for cross-border transactions through 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-21

**Research question**
How is the dual pressure of EU MiCA compliance-driven delistings by major exchanges and the emergence of institutional-backed competitors like Ripple’s RLUSD affecting Tether’s (USDT) global liquidity profile and its role as the primary settlement asset for cross-border transactions through 2025?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

Through 2025-05-21, the evidence favors a regional loss of USDT spot-trading access, not a global decline in liquidity or cross-border settlement. Binance and Kraken removed USDT spot pairs in the European Economic Area (EEA) for MiCA compliance. That took away order books on which EEA customers could trade USDT; it did not show where their orders went. A largely intact global role is the better base case, not a measured outcome: there are no comparable before-and-after global liquidity figures here, no payment data establishing USDT’s settlement rank and no verified evidence that Ripple’s RLUSD took material business from USDT. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=European%20Economic%20Area%20users%20can%20still%20custody%20non-MiCA-compliant%20tokens%2C,a%20plan%20disclosed%20in%20early%20March%2C%20Cointelegraph%20has%20learned.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=Binance%20is%20not%20the%20only%20crypto%20exchange%20delisting%20non-MiCA-compliant,USDT%20in%20the%20EEA%20after%20announcing%20plans%20in%20February.) [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1290513633)

## Evidence

Binance announced a March 31 deadline; April reporting confirmed the removal. Kraken announced plans in February and its EEA spot delistings were also reported by April, but the exact effective date is not established. Neither action amounted to a ban on holding USDT. Binance still offered custody and perpetual contracts, though a derivative is not a substitute for buying USDT on spot. Despite earlier, broader guidance to halt transactions, an ESMA spokesperson clarified on March 5 that custody and transfer services did not themselves violate the rules. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=USDT%20is%20available%20for%20perpetual%20trading%20on%20Binance.%20Source%3A,quarter%20of%202025.%20Delistings%20on%20other%20exchanges%20in%20EEA) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=Binance%20is%20not%20the%20only%20crypto%20exchange%20delisting%20non-MiCA-compliant,USDT%20in%20the%20EEA%20after%20announcing%20plans%20in%20February.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=While%20spot%20trading%20pairs%20in%20tokens%20such%20as%20USDt,the%20affected%20tokens%20and%20trade%20them%20in%20perpetual%20contracts.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=On%20March%205%2C%20a%20spokesperson%20for%20the%20ESMA%20told,crypto%20laws%20are%20changing%20across%20the%20world%20in%202025)

Tether estimated ~46 million new USDT wallets in the first quarter, 13% more than in the previous quarter. That suggests continued uptake going into the delistings, not resilience afterward. The reserve attestation was likewise a snapshot as of March 31, 2025. Neither gives a comparable post-delisting reading of circulating supply (tokens outstanding), trading volume (turnover) or order-book depth (how much can trade near the quoted price). Even unchanged supply could coexist with thinner EEA books. Without matched volume and depth by venue, pair and region, neither the size nor destination of displaced trading is measurable. [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250521133735/https://tether.io/news/tether-approaching-120b-in-u-s-treasuries-confirms-quarterly-operating-profit-over-1b-and-strengthens-global-usdt-demand-in-q1-2025/#:~:text=The%20token%20issuer%20Company%E2%80%99s%20assets%20exceed%20its%20consolidated%20liabilities.,~46%20million%2C%20a%2013%25%20increase%20from%20the%20previous%20quarter.) [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250521133735/https://tether.io/news/tether-approaching-120b-in-u-s-treasuries-confirms-quarterly-operating-profit-over-1b-and-strengthens-global-usdt-demand-in-q1-2025/#:~:text=Tether%20International%2C%20S.A.%20de%20C.V.%20%28TI%29%20today%20published%20its,of%20the%20U.S.%20dollar%20in%20a%20rapidly%20evolving%20economy.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=USDT%20is%20available%20for%20perpetual%20trading%20on%20Binance.%20Source%3A,quarter%20of%202025.%20Delistings%20on%20other%20exchanges%20in%20EEA)

RLUSD was a potential competitor, but its demonstrated pressure on USDT was unquantified. The record provides no verified RLUSD issuance or circulating supply, comparable trading volume or depth, or completed institutional payments. Even a confirmed integration would establish access, not settled value or a switch from USDT. Ripple’s historical MoneyGram relationship involved XRP-based tools, not RLUSD; it cannot fill that gap. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1290513633)

## Outlook

For the rest of 2025, the base case is that EEA spot trading shifts toward compliant pairs or other venues while USDT’s wider role remains largely intact. Removing a pair forces traders who used that book to change how they trade; it does not force a payment provider to change its settlement asset. The strongest alternative is that providers also switch assets and market makers move their quotes to follow that payment flow, weakening USDT beyond the restricted venues. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=Binance%20is%20not%20the%20only%20crypto%20exchange%20delisting%20non-MiCA-compliant,USDT%20in%20the%20EEA%20after%20announcing%20plans%20in%20February.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=On%20March%205%2C%20a%20spokesperson%20for%20the%20ESMA%20told,crypto%20laws%20are%20changing%20across%20the%20world%20in%202025)

## What would change the view

Revise toward a global decline if matched non-EEA books show sustained losses of USDT depth and turnover alongside a falling USDT share of verified corridor payments. To attribute the shift to RLUSD, look for payment providers routing formerly USDT-settled flows through RLUSD in those same corridors. To attribute it to MiCA, look for a sharper change on affected EEA venues around the delistings than on comparable unaffected venues. The regional removals alone establish the loss of access, not either downstream effect. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=European%20Economic%20Area%20users%20can%20still%20custody%20non-MiCA-compliant%20tokens%2C,a%20plan%20disclosed%20in%20early%20March%2C%20Cointelegraph%20has%20learned.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250410200344/https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-halt-spot-usdt-trading-eea-mica-compliance#:~:text=USDT%20is%20available%20for%20perpetual%20trading%20on%20Binance.%20Source%3A,quarter%20of%202025.%20Delistings%20on%20other%20exchanges%20in%20EEA)

## Sources

1.
