question: How can the Consumer Discretionary sector's projected 26.4% earnings growth for 2025 be reconciled with its significant Q1 2025 performance drawdown, and what role do divergent stock returns from constituents like Take-Two, Sony, and Carnival play in this outlook?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-07

**Research question**
How can the Consumer Discretionary sector's projected 26.4% earnings growth for 2025 be reconciled with its significant Q1 2025 performance drawdown, and what role do divergent stock returns from constituents like Take-Two, Sony, and Carnival play in this outlook?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The return window matters. Morningstar’s 10% drop was measured from the broad market’s mid-February peak; it was not the loss from the start to the end of the quarter. For the requested January–March period, the evidence supplies neither a sector benchmark return nor its price-only or dividend-inclusive basis. Neither broad-market figure can substitute for the sector result, and April trading falls outside the comparison. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250402080713/https://www.morningstar.com/markets/13-charts-q1s-dramatic-rotation-stocks#:~:text=Bonds%20were%20a%20safe%20haven%2C%20as%20prices%20rose%20despite,names%20at%20the%20center%20of%20the%20artificial%20intelligence%20boom.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250402080713/https://www.morningstar.com/markets/13-charts-q1s-dramatic-rotation-stocks#:~:text=Strategists%20say%20investors%20should%20brace%20for%20more%20volatility%20in,the%20second%20quarter%20of%202022%2C%20when%20stocks%20fell%2016.85%25.)

Take-Two, Sony and Carnival cannot be credited with driving or offsetting a sector loss on this record. Take-Two’s PlayStation license establishes a commercial link to Sony, not common index membership. The Take-Two share move cited in the historical material concerns a board contest, not the quarter under review. There are no comparable quarter-end returns or verified benchmark weights for any of the companies, and no contemporaneous results or guidance here for Take-Two or Sony. Attribution requires confirming each security’s membership and weight, identifying Sony’s local share or ADR, and measuring returns in the same currency with the same dividend treatment. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1284037165) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20230324140624/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taketwo-sac/take-two-investors-plan-board-takeover-idUSN0720216920070308#:~:text=The%20group%20said%20it%20will%20also%20vote%20to%20reduce,reaching%20a%20high%20of%20%2420.88%20in%20early%20Nasdaq%20trade.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250406175533/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/carnival-corporation--plc-reports-record-setting-first-quarter-operating-results-outperforms-december-guidance-and-raises-full-year-2025-guidance-302407712.html#:~:text=MIAMI%2C%20March%2021%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Carnival%20Corporation%20%26,up%20over%20%24400%20million%20compared%20to%20the%20prior%20year.)

Carnival does offer evidence against a uniform demand slump. On March 21, 2025 it reported record first-quarter revenue of $5.8 billion and raised full-year adjusted net income guidance by $185 million from December, implying growth of over 30 percent versus 2024. Revenue was realized; annual profit growth was still a forecast. Better cruise yields and lower interest expense after refinancing both supported the raise, so it was not purely a demand signal. It is evidence about Carnival’s operations, not its stock return or sector-wide earnings. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250406175533/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/carnival-corporation--plc-reports-record-setting-first-quarter-operating-results-outperforms-december-guidance-and-raises-full-year-2025-guidance-302407712.html#:~:text=MIAMI%2C%20March%2021%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Carnival%20Corporation%20%26,up%20over%20%24400%20million%20compared%20to%20the%20prior%20year.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250406175533/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/carnival-corporation--plc-reports-record-setting-first-quarter-operating-results-outperforms-december-guidance-and-raises-full-year-2025-guidance-302407712.html#:~:text=Adjusted%20net%20income%20guidance%20for%202025%20expected%20to%20be,Carnival%20Corporation%20%26%20plc%27s%20Chief%20Executive%20Officer%20Josh%20Weinstein.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250406175533/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/carnival-corporation--plc-reports-record-setting-first-quarter-operating-results-outperforms-december-guidance-and-raises-full-year-2025-guidance-302407712.html#:~:text=%22While%20we%20are%20not%20completely%20immune%20from%20the%20heightened,to%20make%20their%20vacation%20dollars%20go%20further%2C%22%20said%20Weinstein.)

## Outlook

The base case is that investors became less willing to pay for expected earnings during the quarter. An annual forecast compares profits with a prior-year base; share prices respond to what has changed relative to expectations already priced in. Tariff uncertainty raised the risk of weaker demand and thinner margins, while restrictive rates limited valuation support. Prices could therefore fall immediately even if expected profits remained above the prior year’s level. The reported shift toward defensive stocks supports this interpretation of the market backdrop, but does not prove that sector valuations fell. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250402080713/https://www.morningstar.com/markets/13-charts-q1s-dramatic-rotation-stocks#:~:text=Bonds%20were%20a%20safe%20haven%2C%20as%20prices%20rose%20despite,names%20at%20the%20center%20of%20the%20artificial%20intelligence%20boom.) ## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that prices anticipated broad earnings cuts rather than chiefly reflecting a lower valuation. Once the forecast and return universes are matched, compare forward earnings estimates and valuation multiples for the same constituents from quarter start through the next reporting cycle. Widespread guidance cuts tied to demand or margins, with little change in multiples, would favor the earnings explanation. Stable or rising estimates alongside lower multiples would favor the base case. Carnival’s guidance raise is one observation; the sector estimate and valuation histories needed to decide are missing. question: How should investors reconcile ADP's reported deceleration in private sector hiring, which hit a low of 62,000 jobs in April 2025, with its market price of $325.81, considering the divergent institutional sentiment and neutral analyst targets reported in May 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-07-09

**Research question**
How should investors reconcile ADP's reported deceleration in private sector hiring, which hit a low of 62,000 jobs in April 2025, with its market price of $325.81, considering the divergent institutional sentiment and neutral analyst targets reported in May 2025?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The purported split among institutions and neutral analyst targets in May are unverified question premises. The May archive establishes a Zacks Hold rank, not a consensus dollar target; its performance comparison gives percentage returns, not a dated share price. Without dated holdings changes, target values and a trading date for the quote, investors cannot infer institutional conviction, calculate implied upside or call the quote the cutoff-day close. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250527150349/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/acquisitions-aid-automatic-data-processing-160100284.html#:~:text=Zacks%20Rank%20%26%20Stocks%20to%20Consider%20Automatic%20Data%20Processing,sector%20are%20AppLovin%20APP%20and%20Barrett%20Business%20Services%20BBSI.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250527150349/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/acquisitions-aid-automatic-data-processing-160100284.html#:~:text=Oops%2C%20something%20went%20wrong%20Automatic%20Data%20Processing%2C%20Inc.%20ADP,the%20Zacks%20S%26P%20500%20composite%20in%20the%20said%20period.)

ADP’s April 30, 2025 release confirms a slowdown, not a contraction. April’s 62,000 net additions minus March’s revised 147,000 yield a change of -85,000 jobs in the monthly pace of hiring. Private employment still rose in April. The comparison establishes that the gain was smaller than March’s, but not that April marked a low over a longer period. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250430130339/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/adp-national-employment-report-private-sector-employment-increased-by-62-000-jobs-in-april-annual-pay-was-up-4-5-302442587.html#:~:text=ROSELAND%2C%20N.J.%2C%20April%2030%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Private%20sector,month%2C%20up%20from%20nearly%2010%20million%20when%20it%20launched.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250618011322/https://mediacenter.adp.com/2025-04-30-ADP-National-Employment-Report-Private-Sector-Employment-Increased-by-62,000-Jobs-in-April-Annual-Pay-was-Up-4-5?asPDF#:~:text=ADP%20Media%20Center%20ADP%20National%20Employment%20Report%3A%20Private%20Sector,resources%2Fmining%206%2C000%20Construction%2016%2C000%20Manufacturing%204%2C000%20-%20Service-providing%3A%2034%2C000) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250618011322/https://mediacenter.adp.com/2025-04-30-ADP-National-Employment-Report-Private-Sector-Employment-Increased-by-62,000-Jobs-in-April-Annual-Pay-was-Up-4-5?asPDF#:~:text=-%20Large%20firms%3A%20500%2B%20employees%204.8%25%20To%20see%20Pay,the%20property%20of%20their%20respective%20owners.%20Copyright%20%C2%A9%202025)

## Outlook

The base case is slower growth in the number of workers ADP processes payroll for, not a decline in earnings. Existing employees still need to be paid, the national estimate is not a count of billable additions, and ADP also sells HR software and outsourcing services. Stable pays per client, retention and earnings guidance would support that distinction. The cited earnings results are for fiscal 2024 and cannot confirm it for April. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250430130339/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/adp-national-employment-report-private-sector-employment-increased-by-62-000-jobs-in-april-annual-pay-was-up-4-5-302442587.html#:~:text=ROSELAND%2C%20N.J.%2C%20April%2030%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Private%20sector,month%2C%20up%20from%20nearly%2010%20million%20when%20it%20launched.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250527150349/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/acquisitions-aid-automatic-data-processing-160100284.html#:~:text=Image%20Source%3A%20Zacks%20Investment%20Research%20ADP%20has%20reported%20an,established%20local%2C%20in-country%20software%20solutions%20and%20cloud-based%20multi-country%20solutions.)

## What would change the view

The strongest trim case is that hiring caution persists and turns into payroll contraction at ADP clients. Falling pays per client accompanied by a cut to earnings guidance would connect the labor signal to profits and warrant a trim. Conversely, resilient client payrolls and higher earnings guidance could support a buy if a verified trading price still offered upside against those earnings. [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250618010623/https://mediacenter.adp.com/2025-04-30-ADP-National-Employment-Report-Private-Sector-Employment-Increased-by-62,000-Jobs-in-April-Annual-Pay-was-Up-4-5#:~:text=%22Unease%20is%20the%20word%20of%20the%20day.%20Employers%20are,decisions%20in%20such%20an%20environment.%22%20April%202025%20Report%20Highlights%2A) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250430130339/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/adp-national-employment-report-private-sector-employment-increased-by-62-000-jobs-in-april-annual-pay-was-up-4-5-302442587.html#:~:text=ROSELAND%2C%20N.J.%2C%20April%2030%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20--%20Private%20sector,month%2C%20up%20from%20nearly%2010%20million%20when%20it%20launched.)

April 2025 vs. revised March 2025: change in monthly U.S. private-sector net job additions (jobs) — 62,000 − 147,000 = -85,000 [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250618011322/https://mediacenter.adp.com/2025-04-30-ADP-National-Employment-Report-Private-Sector-Employment-Increased-by-62,000-Jobs-in-April-Annual-Pay-was-Up-4-5?asPDF#:~:text=-%20Large%20firms%3A%20500%2B%20employees%204.8%25%20To%20see%20Pay,the%20property%20of%20their%20respective%20owners.%20Copyright%20%C2%A9%202025) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250618011322/https://mediacenter.adp.com/2025-04-30-ADP-National-Employment-Report-Private-Sector-Employment-Increased-by-62,000-Jobs-in-April-Annual-Pay-was-Up-4-5?asPDF#:~:text=ADP%20Media%20Center%20ADP%20National%20Employment%20Report%3A%20Private%20Sector,resources%2Fmining%206%2C000%20Construction%2016%2C000%20Manufacturing%204%2C000%20-%20Service-providing%3A%2034%2C000)

question: How have the recurring failures in Return on Assets (ROA) and Free Cash Flow (FCF) metrics among emerging AI and infrastructure firms like SMCI, GEV, and RGTI through early 2025 signaled a divergence between sector sentiment and fundamental capital efficiency?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-28

**Research question**
How have the recurring failures in Return on Assets (ROA) and Free Cash Flow (FCF) metrics among emerging AI and infrastructure firms like SMCI, GEV, and RGTI through early 2025 signaled a divergence between sector sentiment and fundamental capital efficiency?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

Through 2025-04-28, Super Micro Computer (SMCI) offers the clearest evidence of investor optimism: its shares rallied 2,000% over two years. But neither that rally nor its reversal establishes that optimism outpaced capital efficiency. For GE Vernova (GEV), the comparison turns on the performance of the business after separation; for Rigetti Computing (RGTI), the clearest valuation evidence concerns an earlier financing. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241111003015/https://www.visualcapitalist.com/super-micro-once-the-hottest-ai-stock-of-2024-has-crashed/#:~:text=What%20Does%20Super%20Micro%20Do%3F%20Super%20Micro%20is%20a,Micro%20include%20CoreWeave%2C%20an%20American%20cloud-computing%20startup%2C%20and%20Tesla.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250306185646/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536525000006/smci-20241231.htm#:~:text=Condensed%20Consolidated%20Statements%20of%20Stockholders%27%20Equity%20for%20the%20Three,2024%20and%202023%20Notes%20to%20Condensed%20Consolidated%20Financial%20Statements) [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287664032) [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1282872736)

## Evidence

SMCI: the price reversal is better evidence of a loss of confidence in reporting than of a decline in asset productivity. Shares fell 20% on the annual filing delay, then rose 12% when the company filed by its extended deadline, even though it disclosed material control weaknesses. Demand was not merely hypothetical: Supermicro supplied servers for Tesla. The filing excerpt identifies comparable half-years ending in December but gives no amounts from which to determine whether that demand produced better ROA or cash flow after capital spending. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20241111003015/https://www.visualcapitalist.com/super-micro-once-the-hottest-ai-stock-of-2024-has-crashed/#:~:text=Around%20the%20same%20time%20this%20report%20was%20released%2C%20Super,be%20associated%20with%20the%20financial%20statements%20prepared%20by%20management%E2%80%9D.) [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1286443691) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250306185646/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536525000006/smci-20241231.htm#:~:text=Condensed%20Consolidated%20Statements%20of%20Stockholders%27%20Equity%20for%20the%20Three,2024%20and%202023%20Notes%20to%20Condensed%20Consolidated%20Financial%20Statements)

RGTI: investors backed future technology, but the evidence does not show that its share price outran operating performance through the cutoff. The October 2021 SPAC announcement estimated a valuation of around US$1.5 billion and described funding for processor development. That was a deal estimate before public trading, not a market reaction to recent earnings. Capital raised from investors is not cash generated by operations; without comparable losses or profits, asset balances, cash spending and dated price reactions, neither recurring inefficiency nor an improving trend can be established. [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1282872736)

GEV: the evidence does not establish that investor optimism outpaced capital efficiency through 2025-04-28. GE Vernova became a separately listed company at the spin-off and sold part of its Steam Power business to EDF in May 2024. Comparing ROA across those events could mistake a change in which businesses contributed earnings and assets for a change in how productively they used those assets. The sale proceeds are not operating cash flow. Without comparable ROA and FCF for the businesses GEV retained, or a share-price reaction to those results, neither recurring weakness nor a market response to improving cash generation is established. [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287664032)

## What would change the view

The base case is firm-specific: reporting risk explains the documented SMCI price swings, while GEV and RGTI lack a matched price-and-performance test. The strongest alternative is that investors correctly anticipated a payoff before it appeared in cash flow. Test it at successive earnings releases: compare net income divided by average total assets and operating cash flow less capital spending against the same fiscal period a year earlier, keeping GEV’s business scope comparable and excluding financing proceeds at RGTI. Rising prices alongside persistently weak ROA and FCF would support divergence; sustained gains in both measures would support the anticipated payoff. A filing-driven bounce alone does not decide between them. [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1286443691) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250306185646/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536525000006/smci-20241231.htm#:~:text=Condensed%20Consolidated%20Statements%20of%20Stockholders%27%20Equity%20for%20the%20Three,2024%20and%202023%20Notes%20to%20Condensed%20Consolidated%20Financial%20Statements) [3](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287664032) [4](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1282872736)

## Sources

1. [Super Micro, Once the Hottest AI Stock of 2024, Has Crashed](https://web.archive.org/web/20241111003015/https://www.visualcapitalist.com/super-micro-once-the-hottest-ai-stock-of-2024-has-crashed/#:~:text=What%20Does%20Super%20Micro%20Do%3F%20Super%20Micro%20is%20a,Micro%20include%20CoreWeave%2C%20an%20American%20cloud-computing%20startup%2C%20and%20Tesla.), available by 2024-11-11.

3. [GE Vernova](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1287664032), available by 2025-04-27.
4. [Rigetti Computing](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1282872736), available by 2025-03-29.

# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-28

**Research question**
Given the TASER segment's 37.1% year-over-year growth in Q4 2024 and its $819 million annual revenue, how should investors interpret President Joshua Isner’s divestment of over $30 million in AXON stock in early 2025 regarding the sustainability of the TASER 10 product cycle?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-04-28, I would not lower expectations for TASER 10 demand because of Axon President Joshua Isner’s reported stock sales. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250405021304/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1069183/000141588924023180/xslF345X05/form4-09102024_110944.xml#:~:text=1.%20Securities%20disposed%20represent%20securities%20withheld%20to%20settle%20the,shares%20and%20prices%20at%20which%20the%20transaction%20was%20effected.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20240901231255/https://www.redlandscommunitynews.com/news/council-approves-549k-for-tasers/article_be330b7c-658a-11ef-9f9a-a3e9107e759c.html#:~:text=The%20Redlands%20City%20Council%20unanimously%20approved%20a%20significant%20purchase,the%20years%2C%20have%20underscored%20the%20need%20for%20an%20upgrade.)

## Evidence

The sale terms that can be checked concern the earlier September transaction. The filing distinguishes a sale of vested shares under a plan adopted on September 15, 2023 from shares withheld for taxes. The September report lists 19,316 shares sold at $357.8836 to $364.7605; even at the top price, that count cannot support its headline of over $9 million. The separate 19,355 shares withheld at $354.62 are not sale proceeds. Neither the older plan nor the filing excerpt verifies the dates, prices, share count, total proceeds or plan status of the alleged early-2025 sales. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20240913095758/https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/axon-president-joshua-isner-sells-over-9m-in-company-stock-93CH-3610637#:~:text=Axon%20president%20Joshua%20Isner%20sells%20over%20%249m%20in%20company,regarding%20the%20number%20of%20shares%20and%20prices%20upon%20request.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250405021304/https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1069183/000141588924023180/xslF345X05/form4-09102024_110944.xml#:~:text=1.%20Securities%20disposed%20represent%20securities%20withheld%20to%20settle%20the,shares%20and%20prices%20at%20which%20the%20transaction%20was%20effected.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20240913095758/https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/axon-president-joshua-isner-sells-over-9m-in-company-stock-93CH-3610637#:~:text=The%20SEC%20filing%20also%20noted%20that%20Isner%20disposed%20of,company%3B%20they%20could%20also%20reflect%20personal%20financial%20management%20decisions.)

Axon’s CFO reported 37% year-over-year growth for the TASER business in Q4 2024, not for TASER 10 alone. The more precise growth rate and the annual segment revenue in the question are unverified question premises. Even if accurate, neither measures model-specific revenue. Earlier reporting identified the model as a contributor to company growth alongside cameras and software, without quantifying its contribution. The segment result supports recent demand across the product line, not an assumption that this model will sustain the same growth rate. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250322063418/https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2025/02/26/axon-enterprise-axon-q4-2024-earnings-call-transcr/#:~:text=Brittany%20Bagley%20--%20Chief%20Financial%20Officer%20Thank%20you%2C%20Josh.,customers%20and%20markets%20while%20driving%20innovation%20in%20our%20technology.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20240913095758/https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/axon-president-joshua-isner-sells-over-9m-in-company-stock-93CH-3610637#:~:text=In%20other%20recent%20news%2C%20Axon%20Enterprise%20has%20been%20the,been%20raised%20to%20between%20%242%20billion%20and%20%242.05%20billion.)

## Outlook

My base case is continued but uneven demand as agencies replace older fleets. Redlands approved 105 devices and accessories under a $549,724.94 agreement spanning five fiscal years. A separate proposed renewal included 50 devices to replace TASER 7 units within a broader equipment contract. These purchases and proposals identify a reason for demand to persist, but a multiyear contract value is neither current model revenue nor evidence that agencies will order at the same pace each year. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20240901231255/https://www.redlandscommunitynews.com/news/council-approves-549k-for-tasers/article_be330b7c-658a-11ef-9f9a-a3e9107e759c.html#:~:text=The%20Redlands%20City%20Council%20unanimously%20approved%20a%20significant%20purchase,the%20years%2C%20have%20underscored%20the%20need%20for%20an%20upgrade.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250419061433/https://www.sunnews.org/city-renews-contract-for-police-body-and-dash-camera-systems/#:~:text=degree%20field%20of%20view%2C%E2%80%9D%20Ezroj%20wrote.%20%E2%80%9CThe%202020%20contract,improve%20daylight%20scenarios%2C%E2%80%9D%20Ezroj%20wrote.%20License%20plate%20reading%20tech) [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250419061433/https://www.sunnews.org/city-renews-contract-for-police-body-and-dash-camera-systems/#:~:text=%E2%80%9COn%20July%2020%2C%202020%2C%20the%20City%20Council%20approved%20Resolution,failures%20related%20to%20aging%20technology%20or%20devices%2C%E2%80%9D%20Ezroj%20wrote.)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside case is that early renewals pulled upgrades forward, leaving fewer fleets ready to buy next. One city negotiated to absorb the final year of its existing contract, so that timing risk is concrete. I would cut demand expectations if successive groups of agencies due for replacement deferred purchases or chose not to upgrade, especially if model-specific orders or shipments also weakened. Continued conversions at scheduled renewals would favor the base case. A contemporaneous filing showing discretionary selling would make Isner’s timing more relevant, but would still say less about the cycle than customers’ buying decisions. [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250419061433/https://www.sunnews.org/city-renews-contract-for-police-body-and-dash-camera-systems/#:~:text=%E2%80%9COn%20July%2020%2C%202020%2C%20the%20City%20Council%20approved%20Resolution,failures%20related%20to%20aging%20technology%20or%20devices%2C%E2%80%9D%20Ezroj%20wrote.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20240901231255/https://www.redlandscommunitynews.com/news/council-approves-549k-for-tasers/article_be330b7c-658a-11ef-9f9a-a3e9107e759c.html#:~:text=The%20Redlands%20City%20Council%20unanimously%20approved%20a%20significant%20purchase,the%20years%2C%20have%20underscored%20the%20need%20for%20an%20upgrade.)

question: Given Cantor Fitzgerald's May 2025 decision to lower their price objective for PTC Therapeutics after months of bullishness, what is the risk-adjusted outlook for Translarna’s regulatory resubmission and its impact on PTCT’s valuation relative to the previous $113.00 target?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-27

**Research question**
Given Cantor Fitzgerald's May 2025 decision to lower their price objective for PTC Therapeutics after months of bullishness, what is the risk-adjusted outlook for Translarna’s regulatory resubmission and its impact on PTCT’s valuation relative to the previous $113.00 target?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The regulatory evidence supports uncertainty, not a change in US approval odds. Translarna’s historical European authorization shows a regulator saw grounds for market access, but it also required a confirmatory trial. A reported false positive in an early assay warrants caution about that assay; it is not a clinical trial result or an FDA judgment. Neither source establishes the status of the US resubmission or how the FDA views its evidence. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1279188920)

## Outlook

The base case is to treat US Translarna sales as contingent on approval and not revise their probability weight solely because of the reported target cut. PTCT’s equity value also reflects assets such as its Huntington’s disease licensing deal. A change in expected milestone proceeds could therefore move the stock target without changing Translarna’s approval odds. That is a competing explanation, not a claim about Cantor’s model. [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1261963545)

## What would change the view

The strongest regulatory alternative is that Cantor explicitly lowered its US approval assumption over doubts about confirmatory efficacy. The test is a dated Cantor note giving the revised objective and identifying that assumption as a reason for the cut. That would establish direction; quantifying the share of the cut would require Cantor’s per-share impact or comparable before-and-after model inputs. FDA feedback on the resubmission would inform the investment outlook, but would not by itself establish Cantor’s rationale. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1279188920)

## Sources

1. [Ataluren](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1279188920), available by 2025-03-07.
2. [PTC Therapeutics](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1261963545), available by 2024-12-08.

question: Given the analysis from Mike Fratantoni and Joel Kan regarding concentrated job gains and persistent inflation, how should mortgage-backed security investors reconcile the MBA's warnings on buyer discouragement with Fratantoni's assessment of the Federal Reserve's data-driven policy challenges and the potential for a spring market recovery in 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-06

**Research question**
Given the analysis from Mike Fratantoni and Joel Kan regarding concentrated job gains and persistent inflation, how should mortgage-backed security investors reconcile the MBA's warnings on buyer discouragement with Fratantoni's assessment of the Federal Reserve's data-driven policy challenges and the potential for a spring market recovery in 2025?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-05-06, agency MBS investors should retain an extension-risk base case for spring 2025 rather than shorten portfolio duration assumptions across the book. The MBA’s seasonally adjusted Purchase Index fell 13% over the Christmas survey interval. That supports caution about buyer demand, but it measures applications, not spring sales or principal returned to investors. Allow for faster sale-related payoffs as an alternative; do not price them as a refinancing wave. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250116091924/https://newslink.mba.org/mba-newslinks/2025/january/1-mba-newslink-monday-jan-6-2025/mortgage-applications-decrease-over-a-two-week-period-in-latest-mba-weekly-survey/#:~:text=%28Image%20courtesy%20of%20Cytonn%20Photography%2FPexels.com%29%20Mortgage%20applications%20decreased%2021.9%25,17%25%20lower%20than%20the%20same%20week%20one%20year%20ago.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=Interest%20rates%20across%20various%20mortgage%20categories%20showed%20upward%20movement.,a%20deeper%20trend%3F%20Let%20us%20know%20in%20the%20comments.)

## Evidence

Mike Fratantoni’s rate explanation and a seasonal lull can both be right. The conforming mortgage rate rose from 6.89% to 6.97%, and unadjusted purchase applications were 17% below the same week a year earlier, so the weakness was not just a drop from a busier part of December. But the headline 21.9% composite decline was seasonally adjusted and measured against two weeks earlier, not against a year earlier as a secondary account says. The MBA’s own release resolves that discrepancy; neither comparison establishes lasting buyer discouragement. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=The%20Market%20Composite%20Index%2C%20which%20measures%20mortgage%20loan%20application,surprise%20at%20a%20time%20when%20housing%20activity%20typically%20halts.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=Interest%20rates%20across%20various%20mortgage%20categories%20showed%20upward%20movement.,a%20deeper%20trend%3F%20Let%20us%20know%20in%20the%20comments.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250116091924/https://newslink.mba.org/mba-newslinks/2025/january/1-mba-newslink-monday-jan-6-2025/mortgage-applications-decrease-over-a-two-week-period-in-latest-mba-weekly-survey/#:~:text=%28Image%20courtesy%20of%20Cytonn%20Photography%2FPexels.com%29%20Mortgage%20applications%20decreased%2021.9%25,17%25%20lower%20than%20the%20same%20week%20one%20year%20ago.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=See%20how%20higher%20rates%20are%20changing%20the%20lending%20landscape,and%20it%20registered%20significant%20changes%20for%20multiple%20lending%20categories.)

## Outlook

The strongest alternative is a spring recovery in existing-home turnover without a Fed cut. Continued employment and wage gains could support purchases at prevailing mortgage rates. When a mortgaged owner sells, the closing can retire the seller’s loan and return principal to the pool even if refinancing that loan would save nothing. The buyer’s application alone does not produce that payoff: the deal may not close, or the seller may have no mortgage. A refinancing forecast needs a separate comparison of available mortgage rates with the rates borrowers already pay. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250504024434/https://www.npr.org/2025/05/02/nx-s1-5383289/jobs-employment-labor-economy-recession-tariffs#:~:text=The%20U.S.%20economy%20was%20already%20faltering%20when%20Trump%20announced,and%20probably%20more%20than%20enough%20to%20outpace%20rising%20prices.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=Interest%20rates%20across%20various%20mortgage%20categories%20showed%20upward%20movement.,a%20deeper%20trend%3F%20Let%20us%20know%20in%20the%20comments.) [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1285323861)

## What would change the view

Raise turnover prepayment assumptions for affected pools if sustained gains in seasonally adjusted purchase applications lead to higher closed existing-home sales and, after the closing lag, faster sale-linked payoffs in servicer data. Faster payoffs among borrowers whose mortgage rates remain below market, alongside subdued refinance applications, would strengthen that interpretation. If applications rebound but closings and payoffs do not, retain the extension case. The available evidence supplies no spring closing series or pool-level payoff attribution with which to confirm the switch. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250116091924/https://newslink.mba.org/mba-newslinks/2025/january/1-mba-newslink-monday-jan-6-2025/mortgage-applications-decrease-over-a-two-week-period-in-latest-mba-weekly-survey/#:~:text=%28Image%20courtesy%20of%20Cytonn%20Photography%2FPexels.com%29%20Mortgage%20applications%20decreased%2021.9%25,17%25%20lower%20than%20the%20same%20week%20one%20year%20ago.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250217144300/https://www.mpamag.com/us/news/general/mortgage-applications-plunge-report/519133#:~:text=Interest%20rates%20across%20various%20mortgage%20categories%20showed%20upward%20movement.,a%20deeper%20trend%3F%20Let%20us%20know%20in%20the%20comments.)

## Sources

1. [Mortgage Applications Decrease Over a Two-Week Period in Latest MBA Weekly Survey - MBA Newslink](https://web.archive.org/web/20250116091924/https://newslink.mba.org/mba-newslinks/2025/january/1-mba-newslink-monday-jan-6-2025/mortgage-applications-decrease-over-a-two-week-period-in-latest-mba-weekly-survey/#:~:text=%28Image%20courtesy%20of%20Cytonn%20Photography%2FPexels.com%29%20Mortgage%20applications%20decreased%2021.9%25,17%25%20lower%20than%20the%20same%20week%20one%20year%20ago.), available by 2025-01-16.

question: To what extent do Saipem’s recent fleet management decisions, specifically the multi-year extension of the Scarabeo 8 contract with Aker BP and the bareboat charter of the Deep Value Driller, indicate a strategic shift towards asset-light operational leverage in the offshore drilling sector through 2027?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-10-28

**Research question**
To what extent do Saipem’s recent fleet management decisions, specifically the multi-year extension of the Scarabeo 8 contract with Aker BP and the bareboat charter of the Deep Value Driller, indicate a strategic shift towards asset-light operational leverage in the offshore drilling sector through 2027?

## Answer

As of 2025-10-28, Saipem’s decisions show selective use of chartered capacity, not a fleet-wide shift to asset-light drilling through 2027. Aker BP committed to more work on Saipem’s own Scarabeo 8 through December 31, 2027. The Deep Value Driller bareboat charter, by contrast, gave Saipem access to a drillship without buying it, but does not establish customer work on that ship through the same date. The distinction for investors is between securing backlog on an existing asset and securing an asset on which to earn future revenue. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20251016133911/https://www.offshore-technology.com/news/saipem-secures-scarabeo-8-contract-extension-with-aker-bp-until-2027/#:~:text=Combine%20business%20intelligence%20and%20editorial%20excellence%20to%20reach%20engaged,to%20perform%20drilling%20activities%20for%20Aker%20BP%20offshore%20Norway.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250808115310/https://www.saipem.com/en/media/news/Saipem-extension-of-contract-with-Aker-BP-for-drilling-activities-offshore-Norway#:~:text=Saipem%3A%20extension%20of%20contract%20with%20Aker%20BP%20for%20drilling,8%20will%20be%20operating%20for%20Aker%20BP%20offshore%20Norway.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250427204207/https://nauticalvoice.com/saipem-firms-up-drillship-option-at-deep-value-driller/37721/#:~:text=Italian%20engineering%20giant%20Saipem%20has%20officially%20amended%20its%20bareboat,time%20or%20reduced%20rates.%20Details%20of%20the%20Charter%20Agreement)

## Evidence

The Norwegian award added contracted rig time, not a rig. The original three-year campaign agreed in March 2022 included two one-year extensions. Aker BP’s latest exercise followed the previous extension directly; the multi-year coverage is cumulative, not a fresh multi-year award. That reduces the risk of having to find work for the owned unit. The reported $325m relates to the original contract, not the incremental backlog value; the extension announcement gives an end date but no price. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20251016133911/https://www.offshore-technology.com/news/saipem-secures-scarabeo-8-contract-extension-with-aker-bp-until-2027/#:~:text=Combine%20business%20intelligence%20and%20editorial%20excellence%20to%20reach%20engaged,to%20perform%20drilling%20activities%20for%20Aker%20BP%20offshore%20Norway.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250812193810/https://www.oedigital.com/news/528467-saipem-s-scarabeo-8-drilling-rig-to-stay-on-duty-for-aker-bp#:~:text=Saipem%E2%80%99s%20Scarabeo%208%20Drilling%20Rig%20to%20Stay%20on%20Duty,contract%20was%20agreed%20between%20the%20companies%20in%20March%202022.) The Deep Value Driller agreement added access to third-party equipment for a defined term. The reported charter starts on July 1, 2023 for 365 days, with a one-year extension option. Those terms do not demonstrate charter coverage through 2027. The projected $54 million to $55 million is revenue for the vessel owner, conditional on idle time and rates—not Saipem drilling backlog or profit. Chartering avoids an upfront purchase, but whether it improves returns depends on the customer revenue Saipem earns relative to hire and operating costs. A sustained rise in the chartered share of customer-contracted rig time, alongside a stable owned rig count, would support a fleet-wide asset-light interpretation; neither deal supplies that comparison. The strongest competing explanation for the charter is deferred acquisition: Saipem obtained a conditional purchase option at $300 million plus remaining hire fees. Exercise would turn hired capacity into owned capacity; the grant alone shows neither a purchase nor a commitment to remain asset-light. question: How will the Federal Aviation Administration's heightened safety oversight and air traffic control constraints impact United Airlines' (UAL) commercial strategy, specifically regarding Andrew Nocella's projections for RASM and the planned retirement of aging widebody fleets like the Boeing 777 and 767?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-02-19

**Research question**
How will the Federal Aviation Administration's heightened safety oversight and air traffic control constraints impact United Airlines' (UAL) commercial strategy, specifically regarding Andrew Nocella's projections for RASM and the planned retirement of aging widebody fleets like the Boeing 777 and 767?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-02-19, Newark’s air traffic control constraints justified treating disruption as a risk to United’s schedule, but not revising Andrew Nocella’s RASM outlook or moving a widebody retirement date. United reported that Newark delays had affected over 343,000 travelers since Nov. 1. That establishes a material hub problem, not the direction of systemwide unit revenue. Separately, United lowered its delivery expectations; it did not identify a corresponding change in retirements. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=According%20to%20a%20report%20by%20The%20Air%20Current%2C%20several,of%20air%20traffic%20control%20staffing%20shortfalls%2C%E2%80%9D%20the%20carrier%20continued.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250215104718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2025/01/28/united-takes-delivery-of-1-000th-jet/#:~:text=United%20is%20slated%20to%20maintain%20its%20fleet-dominant%20position%20as,Destroyed%20in%20South%20Korea%20Fire%20-%20January%2028%2C%202025)

## Evidence

The documented FAA action concerned how much traffic Newark controllers could handle safely. United attributed reduced flows to understaffing at the approach facility. That is distinct from heightened FAA safety oversight of United itself: the available evidence identifies no oversight order restricting United’s network expansion, aircraft introductions or continued use of aging widebodies. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CThe%20FAA%20shortage%20has%20been%20especially%20acute%20at%20its,ATC%20staffing%20issues%20at%20Newark%20causing%20%E2%80%9Csignificant%20disruption%E2%80%9D%20pic.twitter.com%2FrECONIjxzk) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=A%20United%20Boeing%20767-300%20departs%20from%20Newark%20%28Photo%3A%20Shutterstock,days%20in%20November%20alone%2C%20including%20last%20Friday%20through%20Monday.)

## Outlook

Keep the RASM base case unchanged rather than count a capacity cut as a revenue gain. If airlines offer fewer seat miles while demand holds, firmer fares could lift revenue per available seat mile. But delays can disrupt travelers without removing seats, and cancellations or unreliable connections can cost United revenue as well as capacity. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=According%20to%20a%20report%20by%20The%20Air%20Current%2C%20several,of%20air%20traffic%20control%20staffing%20shortfalls%2C%E2%80%9D%20the%20carrier%20continued.)

Keep retirement timing flexible. For 2025, United expected 10 widebody deliveries; its earlier plan for 100 new jets covered all aircraft, not just widebodies. A gap in replacement deliveries could make it worthwhile to keep older Boeing 767s or Triple Sevens flying. United has retained widebodies to meet international demand before, but neither that precedent nor its plan to replace older aircraft establishes a committed retirement date for either type—or a decision to defer one. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250215104718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2025/01/28/united-takes-delivery-of-1-000th-jet/#:~:text=United%20is%20slated%20to%20maintain%20its%20fleet-dominant%20position%20as,Destroyed%20in%20South%20Korea%20Fire%20-%20January%2028%2C%202025) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=A%20United%20Boeing%20767-300%20departs%20from%20Newark%20%28Photo%3A%20Shutterstock,days%20in%20November%20alone%2C%20including%20last%20Friday%20through%20Monday.) [5](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1276625472)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that persistent limits tighten seat supply enough to improve RASM while scarce replacements delay widebody exits. Test the revenue case against sustained cuts to published capacity and stronger realized fares, or explicit revised guidance from Nocella. Test the fleet case separately: another missed delivery would increase the value of keeping aircraft, but a dated fleet plan moving withdrawals later would show that United actually exercised that option. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241214132718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2024/11/27/united-blasts-faa-for-acute-controller-shortage/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CThe%20FAA%20shortage%20has%20been%20especially%20acute%20at%20its,ATC%20staffing%20issues%20at%20Newark%20causing%20%E2%80%9Csignificant%20disruption%E2%80%9D%20pic.twitter.com%2FrECONIjxzk) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250215104718/https://airlinegeeks.com/2025/01/28/united-takes-delivery-of-1-000th-jet/#:~:text=With%20this%20latest%20delivery%2C%20the%20Chicago-based%20carrier%20not%20only,787%20features%20a%20special%20paint%20scheme.%20%28Photo%3A%20Noah%20Escobar%29)

question: Following Genmab’s H1 2025 announcement of its intent to submit an sBLA for epcoritamab in R/R follicular lymphoma, how do the Phase 1b/2 EPCORE NHL-2 results and ongoing Phase 3 combination trials with lenalidomide influence the drug's commercial outlook and regulatory approval probability?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-05

**Research question**
Following Genmab’s H1 2025 announcement of its intent to submit an sBLA for epcoritamab in R/R follicular lymphoma, how do the Phase 1b/2 EPCORE NHL-2 results and ongoing Phase 3 combination trials with lenalidomide influence the drug's commercial outlook and regulatory approval probability?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

On May 2, 2025, Genmab announced that it intended to file an sBLA in the first half of 2025 for subcutaneous epcoritamab plus rituximab and lenalidomide in adults with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after at least one prior systemic therapy. That would add second-line use to a U.S. FL franchise whose accelerated approval covers monotherapy after two or more lines of systemic therapy. As of 2025-08-05, the randomized response result raises the likelihood of FDA approval and makes a materially larger eligible market plausible. It does not establish materially higher sales. The announcement verifies intent and a target filing window—not submission, FDA acceptance or approval of the triplet. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722075653/https://www.onclive.com/view/sbla-submission-planned-for-epcoritamab-rituximab-lenalidomide-in-r-r-fl#:~:text=Genmab%20to%20submit%20supplemental%20biologics%20license%20application%20%28sBLA%29%20to,FDA.%20June%2026%2C%202024.%20Accessed%20May%202%2C%202025.%20https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fda.gov%2Fdrugs%2Fresources-information-approved-drugs%2Ffda-grants-accelerated-approval-epcoritamab-bysp-relapsed-or-refractory-follicular-lymphoma) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723174507/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/genmab-to-submit-supplemental-biologics-license-application-sbla-to-u-s-food-and-drug-administration-for-epcoritamab-plus-rituximab-and-lenalidomide-r2-in-patients-with-relapsed-refractory-follicular-lymphoma-fl#:~:text=COPENHAGEN%2C%20Denmark--%28BUSINESS%20WIRE%29--Genmab%20A%2FS%20%28Nasdaq%3A%20GMAB%29%20announced%20today%20its,forward%20to%20seeing%20the%20full%20results%20from%20the%20study.%E2%80%9D) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250804065721/https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-epcoritamab-bysp-relapsed-or-refractory-follicular-lymphoma#:~:text=FDA%20grants%20accelerated%20approval%20to%20epcoritamab-bysp%20for%20relapsed%20or,prescribing%20information%20for%20Epkinly%20will%20be%20posted%20on%20Drugs%40FDA.)

## Evidence

AbbVie’s Dec. 7, 2024 EPCORE NHL-2 update established depth of response, not the benefit of adding epcoritamab. In the Phase 1b/2 fixed-duration triplet cohort, 111 patients had an overall response rate (ORR) of 96% and a complete response rate of 87%, with median follow-up of over two years. Follow-up is not response duration: the update gives neither a duration-of-response estimate nor cohort-specific adverse-event rates. Without a randomized control, it cannot isolate the triplet’s incremental efficacy, durability or toxicity over rituximab and lenalidomide alone. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723160953/https://news.abbvie.com/2024-12-07-Investigational-Epcoritamab-DuoBody-R-CD3xCD20-Combination-Therapy-Shows-High-Response-Rates-in-Clinical-Trial-of-Patients-With-Relapsed-or-Refractory-R-R-Follicular-Lymphoma-FL#:~:text=Data%20presented%20at%20the%2066th%20Annual%20Meeting%20and%20Exposition,a%20core%20therapy%20for%20the%20treatment%20of%20B-cell%20malignancies.%22)

First-line FL is a separate, longer-term opportunity. The ongoing randomized Phase 3 study NCT06191744 tests the same triplet against chemoimmunotherapy in previously untreated patients, not against rituximab and lenalidomide at relapse. The other ongoing lenalidomide combination study, NCT06508658, tests epcoritamab plus lenalidomide against chemotherapy infusion in relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not FL. The trial descriptions specify neither study’s endpoints or results, nor the exact prior-line threshold for the latter. Neither study adds direct evidence for the proposed relapsed FL label. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723160953/https://news.abbvie.com/2024-12-07-Investigational-Epcoritamab-DuoBody-R-CD3xCD20-Combination-Therapy-Shows-High-Response-Rates-in-Clinical-Trial-of-Patients-With-Relapsed-or-Refractory-R-R-Follicular-Lymphoma-FL#:~:text=About%20Epcoritamab%20Epcoritamab%20is%20an%20IgG1-bispecific%20antibody%20created%20using,these%20investigational%20uses.%20Please%20visit%20www.clinicaltrials.gov%20for%20more%20information.)

## Outlook

Base case: a second-line label would expand the U.S. patient pool, with selective rather than universal uptake. The commercial gain comes from reaching patients at first relapse who may never receive a later line. The sponsor’s estimate of about 15,000 new U.S. FL cases annually is not the number starting second-line treatment. The pivotal trial required suitability for rituximab and lenalidomide and excluded patients refractory to lenalidomide or recently exposed to it. Neither eligible patient flow nor likely market share is quantified. Rituximab and lenalidomide alone remain the immediate alternative; in later lines, mosunetuzumab and CAR T-cell therapies also compete. [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723174507/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/genmab-to-submit-supplemental-biologics-license-application-sbla-to-u-s-food-and-drug-administration-for-epcoritamab-plus-rituximab-and-lenalidomide-r2-in-patients-with-relapsed-refractory-follicular-lymphoma-fl#:~:text=About%20Follicular%20Lymphoma%20%28FL%29%20FL%20is%20typically%20an%20indolent,B%20cells%20and%20induces%20T-cell-mediated%20killing%20of%20CD20%2B%20cells.vi) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722075653/https://www.onclive.com/view/sbla-submission-planned-for-epcoritamab-rituximab-lenalidomide-in-r-r-fl#:~:text=Findings%20from%20EPCORE%20FL-1%20will%20be%20submitted%20later%20in,to%20lenalidomide%20within%2012%20months%20prior%20to%20random%20assignment.) [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723075451/https://www.onclive.com/view/chemotherapy-free-combos-lead-the-way-in-r-r-follicular-lymphoma#:~:text=The%20space%20has%20also%20seen%20the%20approval%20of%20multiple,and%20the%20median%20OS%20was%20NR%20%2895%25%20CI%2C%20NE-NE%29.)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside case is that more responses do not translate into enough additional time without progression to justify a third drug. Fixed-duration treatment is attractive, but epcoritamab monotherapy requires step-up dosing and carries boxed warnings for cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity, plus infection and cytopenia risks. These make comparative safety and monitoring burden important; monotherapy event rates are not triplet rates. Genmab expected to submit the full trial findings for presentation later in 2025. A clinically meaningful PFS advantage with manageable added toxicity would strengthen both the approval and adoption cases; little PFS gain or substantial excess toxicity would weaken them. A final FDA label including second line would confirm eligibility expansion. Actual second-line prescribing, not the label alone, would confirm commercial uptake. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723160953/https://news.abbvie.com/2024-12-07-Investigational-Epcoritamab-DuoBody-R-CD3xCD20-Combination-Therapy-Shows-High-Response-Rates-in-Clinical-Trial-of-Patients-With-Relapsed-or-Refractory-R-R-Follicular-Lymphoma-FL#:~:text=Data%20presented%20at%20the%2066th%20Annual%20Meeting%20and%20Exposition,a%20core%20therapy%20for%20the%20treatment%20of%20B-cell%20malignancies.%22) [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20250804065721/https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-epcoritamab-bysp-relapsed-or-refractory-follicular-lymphoma#:~:text=The%20recommended%20regimen%20consists%20of%20epcoritamab-bysp%20administered%20subcutaneously%20in,submission%20from%20the%20applicant%20to%20facilitate%20the%20FDA%E2%80%99s%20assessment.) [10](https://web.archive.org/web/20250804065721/https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-epcoritamab-bysp-relapsed-or-refractory-follicular-lymphoma#:~:text=Efficacy%20and%20safety%20were%20evaluated%20in%20EPCORE%20NHL-1%20%28Study,all%20events%20were%20grades%201%20%2845%25%29%20or%202%20%289%25%29.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722075653/https://www.onclive.com/view/sbla-submission-planned-for-epcoritamab-rituximab-lenalidomide-in-r-r-fl#:~:text=Findings%20from%20EPCORE%20FL-1%20will%20be%20submitted%20later%20in,to%20lenalidomide%20within%2012%20months%20prior%20to%20random%20assignment.)

## Sources

1. question: How do Mark Delaney’s June 2025 downward revisions for Tesla’s delivery estimates and price targets for Jabil, Belden, and Flex signal a broader shift in Goldman Sachs' outlook for the automotive technology and electronics manufacturing sectors ahead of Q2 earnings?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-06-17

**Research question**
How do Mark Delaney’s June 2025 downward revisions for Tesla’s delivery estimates and price targets for Jabil, Belden, and Flex signal a broader shift in Goldman Sachs' outlook for the automotive technology and electronics manufacturing sectors ahead of Q2 earnings?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-06-17, the June evidence supports a Goldman Sachs cut to Tesla’s delivery and earnings forecasts, not a sector-wide downgrade. Goldman cut its Q2 2025 Tesla delivery estimate from 410,000 to 365,000 vehicles and its share-price target from $295 to $285, but kept its Neutral rating. Ahead of earnings, the distinction matters: Goldman expected fewer Tesla deliveries than consensus, not necessarily weaker demand across automotive technology or electronics manufacturing. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=In%20China%2C%20the%20bank%20said%20that%20while%20April%20and,June%E2%80%99s%20performance%20and%20%22the%20degree%20of%20incentives%20Tesla%20utilizes.%22) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=Reflecting%20these%20trends%2C%20Goldman%20Sachs%20has%20revised%20its%20delivery,%24295.%20Shopify%2C%20Citi%20named%20signature%20picks%20at%20Wells%20Fargo) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=Oops%2C%20something%20went%20wrong%20Goldman%20Sachs%20lowers%20Tesla%20vehicle,US%2C%20and%20Europe%2C%20along%20with%20concerning%20consumer%20survey%20data.)

## Evidence

Goldman based its Tesla revision on weaker monthly data in China, the US and Europe, alongside consumer surveys. China’s April and May figures illustrate why sequential improvement did not resolve the demand concern: they rose slightly from the preceding period but were down 20% year over year. Goldman also lowered its annual delivery assumptions for 2025, 2026 and 2027, so the revision extended beyond the coming quarter. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=Oops%2C%20something%20went%20wrong%20Goldman%20Sachs%20lowers%20Tesla%20vehicle,US%2C%20and%20Europe%2C%20along%20with%20concerning%20consumer%20survey%20data.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=In%20China%2C%20the%20bank%20said%20that%20while%20April%20and,June%E2%80%99s%20performance%20and%20%22the%20degree%20of%20incentives%20Tesla%20utilizes.%22) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=Reflecting%20these%20trends%2C%20Goldman%20Sachs%20has%20revised%20its%20delivery,%24295.%20Shopify%2C%20Citi%20named%20signature%20picks%20at%20Wells%20Fargo)

Independent European registration data favor a Tesla-specific reading over an industry slump. In April, Model Y registrations fell 49.9% year over year while European battery-electric registrations rose 27.7%. The Model Y still led the year-to-date ranking. Those observations are compatible: the monthly figures show lost momentum relative to competitors, while the cumulative ranking reflects sales earlier in the year. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250616220632/https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/tesla-holds-top-spot-in-europes-bev-market-as-model-y-leads-year-to-date/#:~:text=Tesla%20Model%20Y%20Faces%20Fierce%20Monthly%20Competition%20In%20April%2C,combined%20performance%20of%20the%20Renault%205%20and%20Alpine%20A290.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250616220632/https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/tesla-holds-top-spot-in-europes-bev-market-as-model-y-leads-year-to-date/#:~:text=Battery%20electric%20vehicle%20%28BEV%29%20registrations%20in%20Europe%20are%20continuing,continent%20through%20the%20first%20four%20months%20of%20the%20year.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250616220632/https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/tesla-holds-top-spot-in-europes-bev-market-as-model-y-leads-year-to-date/#:~:text=Model%20Y%20Still%20Reigns%20Year-to-Date%20Despite%20the%20ninth-place%20performance,the%20Model%20Y%20continues%20to%20resonate%20with%20European%20buyers.)

## What would change the view

The base case is Tesla demand weakness without a demonstrated common downturn. Test the Tesla call against reported deliveries and June incentives: deliveries above Goldman’s 335,000–395,000 range without heavier incentives would weaken it. The strongest alternative is a common demand slowdown reaching electronics suppliers. Dated Goldman notes showing lower earnings forecasts tied to weaker customer orders across Jabil, Belden and Flex, corroborated by their earnings guidance, would support that reading. Target changes driven by valuation multiples alone would not. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=In%20China%2C%20the%20bank%20said%20that%20while%20April%20and,June%E2%80%99s%20performance%20and%20%22the%20degree%20of%20incentives%20Tesla%20utilizes.%22) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250607020312/https://finance.yahoo.com/news/goldman-sachs-lowers-tesla-vehicle-110523716.html#:~:text=Oops%2C%20something%20went%20wrong%20Goldman%20Sachs%20lowers%20Tesla%20vehicle,US%2C%20and%20Europe%2C%20along%20with%20concerning%20consumer%20survey%20data.)

question: How do the affordability challenges and 'sluggish' market conditions highlighted by Lawrence Yun and Jessica Lautz inform the outlook for US residential real estate volume and pricing, particularly in previously high-growth regions like Texas and Florida throughout mid-2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-11

**Research question**
How do the affordability challenges and 'sluggish' market conditions highlighted by Lawrence Yun and Jessica Lautz inform the outlook for US residential real estate volume and pricing, particularly in previously high-growth regions like Texas and Florida throughout mid-2025?

## Answer

As of 2025-05-11, the midyear base case is fewer U.S. existing-home sales than a year earlier, not a decline in the national median closing price. The affordability concerns attributed to Lawrence Yun and Jessica Lautz are consistent with that distinction: buyers can postpone a purchase without sellers accepting less than comparable homes fetched last year. March closings ran 2.4% below the year-earlier pace, while the median sale price rose 2.7%. For investors, the evidence points more clearly to difficulty finding a buyer than to a lower closing price. The report does not document either economist’s remarks, cover new-home sales or establish greater risk in individual Texas or Florida metros. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Existing-home%20sales%20softened%20in%20March%202025%2C%20dropping%205.9%25%20from,fact%20that%20actual%20labor%20market%20data%20remains%20quite%20healthy.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Home%20prices%20continue%20to%20climb%2C%20but%20growth%20rate%20slows,to%204%2C%20a%20figure%20consistent%20with%20a%20balanced%20market.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Regional%20trends%20show%20that%20affordability%20matters%20Sales%20were%20lower,and%20South%20%28%2B0.6%25%29%20saw%20more%20modest%20increases%20in%20March.)

## Evidence

Modest mortgage-rate relief did not produce a prompt rebound in closings. Rates fell from near 7% to 6.6% when March sales likely went under contract, yet closings fell 5.9% from February to an annual pace of 4.02 million. Pending sales also remained below year-earlier levels into March, a better reason to expect continued weakness than the monthly drop alone. Buyer concerns about finances and job security could explain why some postponed purchases; the evidence does not isolate that effect from affordability. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Existing-home%20sales%20softened%20in%20March%202025%2C%20dropping%205.9%25%20from,fact%20that%20actual%20labor%20market%20data%20remains%20quite%20healthy.)

More inventory gives buyers bargaining room, but it does not establish a price decline. Inventory rose 19.8% to 1.33 million, while the national median closing price reached $403,700. A listing cut is a reduction from a seller’s earlier ask; even after a cut, a home can close above the price a comparable home fetched last year. The report measures neither the frequency of cuts nor changes in the value of the same home. Its finding that 81% of prospective sellers expect at least their asking price measures expectations, not outcomes. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Home%20prices%20continue%20to%20climb%2C%20but%20growth%20rate%20slows,to%204%2C%20a%20figure%20consistent%20with%20a%20balanced%20market.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Recent%20data%20shows%20that%20sellers%20continue%20to%20be%20optimistic.,more%20likely%20to%20be%20about%20where%20there%20are%20buyers.)

## Outlook

Texas and Florida metros merit closer scrutiny, not a blanket forecast of falling prices. The South was among the leaders in adding supply, and its March median completed-sale price rose +0.6% year over year versus 2.7% nationally. The South-minus-U.S. growth gap was -2.1 percentage points: slower appreciation, not depreciation. The question’s characterization of these metros as previously high-growth is an unverified premise. To establish greater exposure, compare each metro’s inventory growth and pending sales with the national figures over the same months, then check whether its completed-sale prices also underperform. Regional data alone cannot establish any of those metro results. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Regional%20trends%20show%20that%20affordability%20matters%20Sales%20were%20lower,and%20South%20%28%2B0.6%25%29%20saw%20more%20modest%20increases%20in%20March.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Home%20prices%20continue%20to%20climb%2C%20but%20growth%20rate%20slows,to%204%2C%20a%20figure%20consistent%20with%20a%20balanced%20market.)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that buyers return in time for the peak selling season and absorb the added listings. Realtor.com’s forecast of modest full-year sales growth is not inconsistent with a sluggish March: seasonally adjusted year-to-date sales were only roughly half a percentage point behind the prior year, and nearly half of annual existing-home sales typically occur in the coming busy months. A sustained shift to year-over-year gains in pending sales followed by gains in closings would overturn the weak-volume case. Conversely, rising months of supply followed by sustained year-over-year declines in the national median closing price—not just more asking-price cuts—would favor a downturn in both volume and pricing. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=What%20this%20data%20means%20for%20what%E2%80%99s%20ahead%20this%20year,these%20busy%20months.%20Home%20sellers%20are%20optimistic%2C%20but%20buyers%3F) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Home%20prices%20continue%20to%20climb%2C%20but%20growth%20rate%20slows,to%204%2C%20a%20figure%20consistent%20with%20a%20balanced%20market.)

## Checked calculations

- C1. March 2025 year-over-year median completed-sale price growth: South minus U.S.; no Texas or Florida metro data (percentage points) — +0.6 − 2.7 = -2.1 [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Regional%20trends%20show%20that%20affordability%20matters%20Sales%20were%20lower,and%20South%20%28%2B0.6%25%29%20saw%20more%20modest%20increases%20in%20March.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250429050020/https://www.realtor.com/research/existing-home-sales-march-2025/#:~:text=Home%20prices%20continue%20to%20climb%2C%20but%20growth%20rate%20slows,to%204%2C%20a%20figure%20consistent%20with%20a%20balanced%20market.)

## Sources

question: How is Eni's 'satellite' capital allocation strategy—evidenced by the Plenitude stake sale and UK asset consolidation with Ithaca Energy—financing its aggressive expansion into global LNG markets and supporting its 2025 upstream production growth targets?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-07-21

**Research question**
How is Eni's 'satellite' capital allocation strategy—evidenced by the Plenitude stake sale and UK asset consolidation with Ithaca Energy—financing its aggressive expansion into global LNG markets and supporting its 2025 upstream production growth targets?

## Answer

As of 2025-07-21, the best-supported conclusion is that Eni reduced the capital it needed to supply itself, not that it spent satellite proceeds on LNG. Eni reported €3.1 bln of combined investment by EIP in Plenitude and KKR in Enilive—not proceeds from Plenitude alone. The Ithaca deal pooled UK assets rather than documenting a cash sale. Both moves gave Eni more flexibility, but neither establishes a payment into LNG or shows that Ithaca production was needed to meet the 2025 upstream target. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=Enilive%20and%20Plenitude%20together%20generated%20%E2%82%AC1.9%20bln%20EBITDA%20in,with%20a%20view%20of%20maximizing%20growth%20options%20and%20returns.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250716173542/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/eni-capital-markets-update-2025-2028.html#:~:text=Eni%20has%20made%20significant%20positive%20steps%20in%20portfolio%20in,back%20%E2%82%AC1.5%20Bln%20of%20shares%20in%20the%202025%20programme.)

## Evidence

The transition deals matter because outside investors shared the cost of growth while Eni retained control of Plenitude. Eni describes EIP increasing its Plenitude interest to 10% and KKR acquiring 25% of Enilive. It describes KKR’s subsequent increase to 30% as agreed, not as closed; the record does not support adding that increment to completed proceeds. Nor is Eni’s claim of more than €21 bln of enterprise value unlocked a measure of cash received by the parent. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=Enilive%20and%20Plenitude%20together%20generated%20%E2%82%AC1.9%20bln%20EBITDA%20in,with%20a%20view%20of%20maximizing%20growth%20options%20and%20returns.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250517132212/https://corporate.eniplenitude.com/en/media/press-release/finance-strategy-reports/08-05-2025-Plenitude-publishes-2024-financial-statements-Sustainability-and-Impact-Report#:~:text=Stefano%20Goberti%2C%20CEO%20of%20Plenitude%2C%20said%3A%20%E2%80%9CPlenitude%20achieved%20solid,GW%20of%20renewable%20capacity.%20Plenitude%20Press%20Office%20-%20Milan) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=%E2%80%9C2024%20was%20an%20exceptional%20year%20of%20growth%20and%20value,transition-related%20satellite%2C%20leveraging%20our%20existing%20skills%20and%20asset%20positions.)

Eni’s LNG expansion combines project ownership with purchases of future supply. Its Qatar North Field East venture dates to 2022, before the reported transition investments, so those deals cannot explain the original equity commitment. The Venture Global agreement gives Eni its first long-term US supply and supports a goal of approximately 20 MTPA of contracted volumes by 2030. Contracted tonnes measure portfolio scale, not cash invested in liquefaction; the announcement identifies no satellite-funded payment. [5](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1300638085) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=Enilive%20and%20Plenitude%20together%20generated%20%E2%82%AC1.9%20bln%20EBITDA%20in,with%20a%20view%20of%20maximizing%20growth%20options%20and%20returns.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250720233134/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/07/eni-announces-20-year-sales-purchase-agreement-with-venture-global.html#:~:text=The%20agreement%20is%20Eni%E2%80%99s%20first%20long%20term%20LNG%20supply,across%20key%20markets%20worldwide.%20Freephone%20for%20shareholders%20%28from%20Italy%29)

## Outlook

For 2025, the base case is that field start-ups and rising output at existing projects must do the operational work of growing production; exchanging UK fields for exposure to a combined producer does not itself create new barrels. The distinction matters because Eni’s reported 3% growth was a 2024 result driven by start-ups and Neptune integration, not the following year’s target. The available guidance does not quantify the target or separate field additions, declines, disposals and Eni’s attributable Ithaca volumes. New output is therefore a testable driver, not a proven exclusive source of growth. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=%E2%80%9C2024%20was%20an%20exceptional%20year%20of%20growth%20and%20value,transition-related%20satellite%2C%20leveraging%20our%20existing%20skills%20and%20asset%20positions.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=Enilive%20and%20Plenitude%20together%20generated%20%E2%82%AC1.9%20bln%20EBITDA%20in,with%20a%20view%20of%20maximizing%20growth%20options%20and%20returns.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=FY%20%E2%80%9924%20adjusted%20operating%20cash%20flow%20of%20%E2%82%AC13.6%20bln,of%20the%20Press%20Release%20is%20available%20in%20PDF%20format.)

## What would change the view

The strongest alternative is that Eni did use parent-level receipts for an LNG payment, or that its share of Ithaca’s existing output materially lifted reported production even without new field output. The financial test is a disclosure matching a completed transaction’s parent cash receipt to an LNG expenditure; aggregate cash flow cannot do that, particularly when Eni also prioritizes shareholder distributions. The production test is a year-on-year reconciliation showing output on a consistent ownership basis and isolating the change attributable to Ithaca. A flat field base with growth explained by that change would overturn the operational base case. [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=FY%20%E2%80%9924%20adjusted%20operating%20cash%20flow%20of%20%E2%82%AC13.6%20bln,of%20the%20Press%20Release%20is%20available%20in%20PDF%20format.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250716173542/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/eni-capital-markets-update-2025-2028.html#:~:text=Eni%20has%20made%20significant%20positive%20steps%20in%20portfolio%20in,back%20%E2%82%AC1.5%20Bln%20of%20shares%20in%20the%202025%20programme.) [8](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1282433070) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250718040231/https://www.eni.com/en-IT/media/press-release/2025/02/2024-fourth-quarter-results.html#:~:text=Enilive%20and%20Plenitude%20together%20generated%20%E2%82%AC1.9%20bln%20EBITDA%20in,with%20a%20view%20of%20maximizing%20growth%20options%20and%20returns.)
