question: Following the 32.68% surge in MRUS shares in late May 2025, how does the interim Phase 2 data for petosemtamab redefine Merus N.V.'s valuation? Specifically, does Needham & Company’s $83.00 price target sufficiently account for the drug’s competitive efficacy in HNSCC and its potential 2026 Phase 3 milestones?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-05-27

**Research question**
Following the 32.68% surge in MRUS shares in late May 2025, how does the interim Phase 2 data for petosemtamab redefine Merus N.V.'s valuation? Specifically, does Needham & Company’s $83.00 price target sufficiently account for the drug’s competitive efficacy in HNSCC and its potential 2026 Phase 3 milestones?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The interim Phase 2 result is evidence of tumor response, not proof that petosemtamab outperforms pembrolizumab. The report gives no denominator, matched control, response duration or comparative toxicity. Pembrolizumab’s HNSCC response-based approval concerned patients whose disease had progressed after platinum chemotherapy; the quoted 41 percent pembrolizumab response rate comes from a biomarker-selected lung cancer subgroup, not HNSCC. Neither establishes the incremental benefit to price into Merus shares. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250526170311/https://www.timothysykes.com/news/merus-nv-mrus-news-2025_05_23-2/#:~:text=Merus%20N.V.%E2%80%99s%20petosemtamab%20antibody%20announcement%20has%20triggered%20significant%20investor,financial%20success%2C%20but%20intrinsic%20value%20enhancement%20in%20health%20research.) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1281856655) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250125131225/https://www.merck.com/news/fda-approves-keytruda-pembrolizumab-for-the-treatment-of-patients-with-metastatic-non-small-cell-lung-cancer-whose-tumors-express-pd-l1-with-disease-progression-on-or-after-platinum-containing/#:~:text=Data%20Supporting%20FDA%20Accelerated%20Approval%20in%20Advanced%20NSCLC%20The,%2844%25%29%2C%20cough%20%2829%25%29%2C%20decreased%20appetite%20%2825%25%29%2C%20and%20dyspnea%20%2823%25%29.)

## Outlook

My base case gives petosemtamab credit for clinical activity but discounts future sales for the risk that pivotal trials fail to show durable benefit over standard care. The reported response rate is not a probability of trial success. Nor do the materials establish what Merus guided to in 2026: the identified upcoming event was an ASCO presentation. Without dated company guidance, I would not assume that enrollment, a pivotal efficacy readout or approval was scheduled for that year, or bring revenue forward on that basis. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250526170311/https://www.timothysykes.com/news/merus-nv-mrus-news-2025_05_23-2/#:~:text=Key%20presentation%20expected%20at%20the%20ASCO%20Annual%20Meeting%20to,breakdown%20below.%20Quick%20Overview%20of%20Merus%20N.V.%E2%80%99s%20Financial%20Metrics) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250526170311/https://www.timothysykes.com/news/merus-nv-mrus-news-2025_05_23-2/#:~:text=Merus%20N.V.%E2%80%99s%20petosemtamab%20antibody%20announcement%20has%20triggered%20significant%20investor,financial%20success%2C%20but%20intrinsic%20value%20enhancement%20in%20health%20research.)

## What would change the view

The strongest upside case is that the early responses translate into longer disease control or survival with tolerable toxicity against the relevant HNSCC standard. A randomized result showing that benefit would justify a higher probability of commercial success; short-lived responses or no advantage over the control would weaken the case despite the initial response rate. A dated Needham model would then allow a separate valuation test: whether its assumed probability of success and sales already capture that benefit. question: How do the positive Phase 3 data for aficamten and the reported regulatory delay in May 2025 influence the investment thesis for Cytokinetics (CYTK), particularly given Barclays' price target reduction from $55 to $53 and the company’s push toward commercialization in the obstructive HCM market?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-07-16

**Research question**
How do the positive Phase 3 data for aficamten and the reported regulatory delay in May 2025 influence the investment thesis for Cytokinetics (CYTK), particularly given Barclays' price target reduction from $55 to $53 and the company’s push toward commercialization in the obstructive HCM market?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-07-16, wait for FDA action before buying Cytokinetics (CYTK). Aficamten’s positive Phase 3 result in obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) justifies preparing for launch. It does not yet justify counting on a fast launch: the FDA’s three-month extension to December 26, 2025 puts the terms of risk monitoring, not just approval, at the center of the investment decision. Those terms could determine whether clinicians have a practical reason to choose aficamten over Camzyos. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=Cytokinetics%20is%20a%20specialty%20cardiovascular%20biopharmaceutical%20company%2C%20building%20on,and%20follow%20us%20on%20X%2C%20LinkedIn%2C%20Facebook%20and%20YouTube.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=SOUTH%20SAN%20FRANCISCO%2C%20Calif.%2C%20May%2001%2C%202025%20%28GLOBE%20NEWSWIRE%29,engagement%20with%20the%20FDA%20regarding%20the%20NDA%20for%20aficamten.%E2%80%9D) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215204627/https://dhpp.hpfb-dgpsa.ca/review-documents/resource/SBD1684173887386#:~:text=The%20most%20commonly%20reported%20adverse%20events%20in%20patients%20receiving,educational%20materials%20for%20risk%20minimization%20have%20also%20been%20developed.)

## Evidence

SEQUOIA-HCM strengthens the case that aficamten can benefit patients, but not the case that it will displace mavacamten. Cytokinetics reports a positive pivotal trial, and the published record includes analyses of symptoms and health status. The available excerpts give neither numerical treatment effects nor a head-to-head comparison. Mavacamten has been approved in the US since April 2022: that validates the drug class but also means aficamten would enter a market with an established alternative. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=Cytokinetics%20is%20a%20specialty%20cardiovascular%20biopharmaceutical%20company%2C%20building%20on,and%20follow%20us%20on%20X%2C%20LinkedIn%2C%20Facebook%20and%20YouTube.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20240930184320/https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2024.08.064#:~:text=6.%20Maron%20M.S.%2C%20Masri%20A.%2C%20Nassif%20M.E.%2C%20et%20al.,Am%20Coll%20Cardiol%20.%20Published%20online%20September1%2C%202024.%20https%3A%2F%2Fdoi.org%2F10.1016%2Fj.jacc.2024.08.015.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20240930184320/https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2024.08.064#:~:text=9.%20Sherrod%20C.F.I.V.%2C%20Saberi%20S.%2C%20Nassif%20M.E.%2C%20et%20al.,Am%20Coll%20Cardiol%20.%20Published%20online%20September1%2C%202024.%20https%3A%2F%2Fdoi.org%2F10.1016%2Fj.jacc.2024.08.002.) [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1294252700)

The delay is verified by Cytokinetics’ May 01, 2025 announcement. The FDA accepted the application without a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS), then requested one during review and treated its submission as a major amendment. No new clinical data or studies were requested. That favors a delay to review the safety plan over an interpretation that efficacy failed; it does not mean the FDA has agreed to the lighter monitoring burden that investors might hope for. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=SOUTH%20SAN%20FRANCISCO%2C%20Calif.%2C%20May%2001%2C%202025%20%28GLOBE%20NEWSWIRE%29,engagement%20with%20the%20FDA%20regarding%20the%20NDA%20for%20aficamten.%E2%80%9D) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20forward-looking%20statements%20for,of%20Cytokinetics%20in%20the%20U.S.%20and%20certain%20other%20countries.)

## Outlook

My base case is gradual specialist uptake if approved, with launch spending preceding sales. Camzyos requires monitoring because excessive suppression of contraction can lead to heart failure; its experience shows why monitoring matters, not what aficamten’s final rules will be. Cytokinetics was already preparing its specialty cardiology business when it reported a $526.2 million net loss for 2023 and $655.4 million in year-end cash, equivalents and investments. That loss is not a launch budget, and the historical balance cannot establish current runway. Staged preparation is reasonable; the evidence does not show that rapid uptake will cover its cost. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215204627/https://dhpp.hpfb-dgpsa.ca/review-documents/resource/SBD1684173887386#:~:text=The%20most%20commonly%20reported%20adverse%20events%20in%20patients%20receiving,educational%20materials%20for%20risk%20minimization%20have%20also%20been%20developed.) [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20241213093100/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/02/27/2836411/35409/en/Cytokinetics-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-2023-Financial-Results.html#:~:text=SOUTH%20SAN%20FRANCISCO%2C%20Calif.%2C%20Feb.%2027%2C%202024%20%28GLOBE%20NEWSWIRE%29,for%20Cytokinetics%20and%20all%20stakeholders.%E2%80%9D%20aficamten%20%28cardiac%20myosin%20inhibitor%29)

## What would change the view

The strongest case for buying now is that the extension proves procedural and the final label makes aficamten materially easier to prescribe than Camzyos. Waiting would then risk missing a gain on approval. I would reconsider on a final US label and REMS showing fewer monitoring steps, then test that advantage against payer coverage, patient starts and launch spending. Comparable monitoring requirements or weak starts despite coverage would favor continued caution. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250518134946/https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/cytokinetics-announces-new-pdufa-date-for-aficamten-in-obstructive-hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy#:~:text=SOUTH%20SAN%20FRANCISCO%2C%20Calif.%2C%20May%2001%2C%202025%20%28GLOBE%20NEWSWIRE%29,engagement%20with%20the%20FDA%20regarding%20the%20NDA%20for%20aficamten.%E2%80%9D) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20241215204627/https://dhpp.hpfb-dgpsa.ca/review-documents/resource/SBD1684173887386#:~:text=The%20most%20commonly%20reported%20adverse%20events%20in%20patients%20receiving,educational%20materials%20for%20risk%20minimization%20have%20also%20been%20developed.)

Cozadd’s consistent equity divestments totaling over 20,000 shares between late 2024 and April 2025, how does this insider activity reflect the long-term growth sustainability and competitive positioning of Jazz Pharmaceuticals' primary revenue driver, the low-sodium narcolepsy treatment Xywav?

# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-28

**Research question**
Given Bruce C. Cozadd’s consistent equity divestments totaling over 20,000 shares between late 2024 and April 2025, how does this insider activity reflect the long-term growth sustainability and competitive positioning of Jazz Pharmaceuticals' primary revenue driver, the low-sodium narcolepsy treatment Xywav?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The succession coverage contains no SEC insider ownership filings, so the sale dates, frequency, total and size relative to Cozadd’s remaining stake cannot be verified from the supplied record. To check the scale, use the transaction dates in the filings, count distinct sale dates, and sum reported sales without double-counting amendments or treating tax withholding as a sale. Then compare the total with his reported holdings after the last sale, keeping direct and indirect ownership separate. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250215060310/https://www.fiercepharma.com/pharma/cozadds-coda-jazz-unveils-succession-plan-longtime-ceo-and-co-founder-plots-retirement#:~:text=Cozadd%27s%20coda%3A%20Jazz%20unveils%20succession%20plan%20as%20longtime%20CEO,company%20and%20beyond%2C%20Jazz%20said%20in%20a%20Monday%20release.)

## What would change the view

Test the product outlook and the trading explanation separately. Sustained declines in Xywav new prescriptions or retention alongside rising Lumryz uptake would favor competitive erosion; stable retention and growing new starts would support durable demand. For the trades, reconcile the shares sold in Cozadd’s SEC ownership filings and check whether the disclosures identify a trading plan adopted before the sales. A matching plan would favor planned selling; sales outside a plan would leave motive open, not prove that Cozadd expected weaker prescribing. question: Given the 99.7% strike mandate from the Canadian Union of Public Employees and CEO Michael Rousseau's warnings of an unsteady economic outlook, what is the projected impact of a potential labor walkout on Air Canada’s operational margins and its strategic growth initiatives for the remainder of 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-12

**Research question**
Given the 99.7% strike mandate from the Canadian Union of Public Employees and CEO Michael Rousseau's warnings of an unsteady economic outlook, what is the projected impact of a potential labor walkout on Air Canada’s operational margins and its strategic growth initiatives for the remainder of 2025?

## Answer

As of 2025-08-12, keep Air Canada’s second-half 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin forecast and growth plans unchanged in the base case. CUPE’s 99.7% strike mandate creates a credible risk of lost revenue during peak summer travel, but it is not a walkout. An extended stoppage would warrant a lower margin forecast; the available disclosures neither quantify that downside nor show that management has already cut guidance because of it. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250806181556/https://openjaw.com/newsroom/airline/2025/08/05/air-canada-flight-attendants-approve-strike-vote-by-99-7/#:~:text=The%20Air%20Canada%20component%20of%20the%20Canadian%20Union%20of,release%20issued%20just%20after%205%20p.m.%20EDT%20on%2005AUG.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250806181556/https://openjaw.com/newsroom/airline/2025/08/05/air-canada-flight-attendants-approve-strike-vote-by-99-7/#:~:text=A%20strike%20vote%20is%20a%20necessary%20precursor%20for%20legal,%243%20per%20hour%20%E2%80%93%20in%20the%20past%2025%20years.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803160005/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/air-canada-reports-second-quarter-2025-financial-results-302515317.html#:~:text=Factors%20that%20may%20cause%20results%20to%20differ%20materially%20from,%22Risk%20Factors%22%20of%20Air%20Canada%27s%20Second%20Quarter%202025%20MD%26A.)

## Evidence

CEO Michael Rousseau reported a second-quarter adjusted EBITDA margin of 16.1%, distinct from the operating margin of 7.4%. The former is the benchmark for this forecast, not a second-half target. Management identified both economic uncertainty and labour costs as risks; that disclosure does not establish a specific strike allowance. Without a second-half margin target, a cancellation estimate or a likely stoppage duration, a numerical margin cut would imply more precision than the evidence supports. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803160005/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/air-canada-reports-second-quarter-2025-financial-results-302515317.html#:~:text=MONTREAL%2C%20July%2028%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20-%20Air%20Canada%20today,11.6%20million%20customers%20this%20quarter%20with%20care%20and%20class.%22) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803160005/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/air-canada-reports-second-quarter-2025-financial-results-302515317.html#:~:text=Factors%20that%20may%20cause%20results%20to%20differ%20materially%20from,%22Risk%20Factors%22%20of%20Air%20Canada%27s%20Second%20Quarter%202025%20MD%26A.)

## Outlook

The network change already under way is a response to demand, not to the strike vote. U.S. transborder passenger revenue fell 11 per cent year over year in the second quarter, and Air Canada was shifting capacity toward stronger international markets. If bargaining avoids material cancellations, that redeployment and the focus on premium traffic can continue. A brief walkout could interrupt the summer schedule without invalidating the commercial case for those routes. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250807013156/https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/company-news/2025/07/29/air-canada-reports-q2-earnings-of-186-million-in-challenging-environment/#:~:text=Published%3A%20July%2029%2C%202025%20at%207%3A35AM%20EDT%20MONTREAL%20%E2%80%94,domestic%2C%20Atlantic%20and%20Latin%20American%20markets%20saw%20a%20boost.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803160005/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/air-canada-reports-second-quarter-2025-financial-results-302515317.html#:~:text=MONTREAL%2C%20July%2028%2C%202025%20%2FPRNewswire%2F%20-%20Air%20Canada%20today,11.6%20million%20customers%20this%20quarter%20with%20care%20and%20class.%22)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside case is a sustained peak-season stoppage. CUPE said it could issue 72-hour notice on 13AUG; a legal strike could begin as early as Aug. 16. Notice would raise the risk, but cancellations and the pace of schedule recovery would determine the forecast change: fares lost rather than rebooked, continuing fixed costs and passenger reaccommodation would squeeze adjusted EBITDA margin. Lower the second-half estimate if material cancellations emerge; revise growth plans if disruption persists long enough to force route deferrals or a sustained capacity reduction. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250806181556/https://openjaw.com/newsroom/airline/2025/08/05/air-canada-flight-attendants-approve-strike-vote-by-99-7/#:~:text=The%20Air%20Canada%20component%20of%20the%20Canadian%20Union%20of,release%20issued%20just%20after%205%20p.m.%20EDT%20on%2005AUG.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250805224450/https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/air-canada-strike-vote-1.7601893#:~:text=Union%20representing%20Air%20Canada%20flight%20attendants%20vote%20to%20strike,as%20soon%20as%20Aug.%2016%20if%20agreement%20isn%E2%80%99t%20reached)

question: How do the operational headwinds at Mozal Aluminium and the reported $203 million net loss reconcile with the upward trend in consensus EPS estimates and the shift in major analyst ratings from 'strong-buy' to 'hold' between April and July 2025 for South32 Limited?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-12

**Research question**
How do the operational headwinds at Mozal Aluminium and the reported $203 million net loss reconcile with the upward trend in consensus EPS estimates and the shift in major analyst ratings from 'strong-buy' to 'hold' between April and July 2025 for South32 Limited?

## Answer

Hold South32 as of 2025-08-12. The strongest reason is the July warning about Mozal, not the historical group loss or the reported analyst rating. South32 owns 63.7% of the smelter, and neither the price nor the availability of power beyond March 2026 was assured. That puts future production at risk even if group earnings improve. The reported April–July rise in consensus EPS and shift from ‘strong-buy’ to ‘hold’ are unverified question premises, not the basis for this recommendation. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250808135325/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/mozal-aluminium-update-0x6b38e9db405d6762.pdf?sfvrsn=194a7c6e_0#:~:text=markets.%20Mozal%20contributes%20approximately%20three%20percent%20of%20national%20gross,Standard%20Bank%20of%20South%20Africa%20Limited%2014%20July%202025) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250808135325/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/mozal-aluminium-update-0x6b38e9db405d6762.pdf?sfvrsn=194a7c6e_0#:~:text=Registered%20Office%20Level%202%2C%20100%20St%20Georges%20Terrace%2C%20Perth,produces%20high-%20quality%2C%20primary%20aluminium%20for%20domestic%20and%20export)

## Evidence

The loss was a group result for the year ended 30 June 2024, not an April–July trading loss or the charge flagged in July. In US$M, the statutory after-tax result attributable to members was (203), while group underlying earnings were positive at 380. Mozal’s own FY24 underlying EBIT loss was US$30M. These measures answer different questions: the group net loss neither measures Mozal’s operating loss nor establishes the direction of future group EPS. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127074304/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/appendix-4e-and-2024-financial-results-and-outlook-0x52e4ee2a2b6a29f5.pdf?sfvrsn=c657442d_0#:~:text=APPENDIX%204E%20SOUTH32%20LIMITED%20%28ABN%2084%20093%20732%20597%29,597%20Registered%20in%20Australia%20This%20page%20is%20intentionally%20blank) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127074304/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/appendix-4e-and-2024-financial-results-and-outlook-0x52e4ee2a2b6a29f5.pdf?sfvrsn=c657442d_0#:~:text=Mozal%20Aluminium%20is%20located%20near%20Maputo%2C%20Mozambique%2C%20and%20is,to%20operation%20as%20part%20of%20the%20recovery%20plan.%20Capital)

The consensus evidence does not identify the EPS forecast year, whether EPS is statutory or adjusted, or whether estimates rose for the same fiscal year across both snapshots. A higher estimate for a later year need not be an upward revision. Nor does the reported change in the headline rating establish broker downgrades: a change in which brokers were counted could also shift the consensus. The available consensus excerpt contains a disclaimer, not dated forecasts, contributor counts or individual recommendations. Neither explanation for the rating change can be verified. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250725221826/https://www.sharenet.co.za/v3/sens_display.php?tdate=20250721070500&seq=1#:~:text=Sharenet%20does%20not%20accept%20any%20liability%20whatsoever%20for%20reliance,not%20occur%29.%20SOUTH32%20LIMITED%20-%20Quarterly%20Report%20June%202025)

## Outlook

The operating base case is to treat Mozal’s earlier FY26 forecast of 370kt as conditional, not to assume either full production or closure. That forecast already depended on a power extension. What changed in July was that an affordable tariff remained out of reach, drought threatened HCB’s ability to supply enough electricity, and South32 expected a FY25 impairment whose size it had not yet determined. A genuine rise in group EPS forecasts could coexist with that deterioration if gains elsewhere offset Mozal weakness or if the forecast measure excludes the impairment. Neither explanation is confirmed. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127074304/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/appendix-4e-and-2024-financial-results-and-outlook-0x52e4ee2a2b6a29f5.pdf?sfvrsn=c657442d_0#:~:text=Mozal%20Aluminium%20is%20located%20near%20Maputo%2C%20Mozambique%2C%20and%20is,to%20operation%20as%20part%20of%20the%20recovery%20plan.%20Capital) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250808135325/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/mozal-aluminium-update-0x6b38e9db405d6762.pdf?sfvrsn=194a7c6e_0#:~:text=Registered%20Office%20Level%202%2C%20100%20St%20Georges%20Terrace%2C%20Perth,produces%20high-%20quality%2C%20primary%20aluminium%20for%20domestic%20and%20export)

## What would change the view

The strongest upside case is that the negotiations secure enough power at a price that lets Mozal continue its recovery. A signed supply agreement extending beyond March 2026, followed by confirmed production guidance, would weaken the case for holding rather than buying. A guidance cut tied to insufficient or uneconomic power would strengthen the downside case. To give the consensus trend weight in either decision, compare the same brokers’ forecasts for the same fiscal year and earnings measure, and check their dated recommendations separately from changes in coverage. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250808135325/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/mozal-aluminium-update-0x6b38e9db405d6762.pdf?sfvrsn=194a7c6e_0#:~:text=Registered%20Office%20Level%202%2C%20100%20St%20Georges%20Terrace%2C%20Perth,produces%20high-%20quality%2C%20primary%20aluminium%20for%20domestic%20and%20export) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127074304/https://www.south32.net/docs/default-source/exchange-releases/appendix-4e-and-2024-financial-results-and-outlook-0x52e4ee2a2b6a29f5.pdf?sfvrsn=c657442d_0#:~:text=Mozal%20Aluminium%20is%20located%20near%20Maputo%2C%20Mozambique%2C%20and%20is,to%20operation%20as%20part%20of%20the%20recovery%20plan.%20Capital)

question: How do the durable Phase 1 TTR reduction results and the rapid advancement of the Phase 3 MAGNITUDE trials for nexiguran ziclumeran (nex-z) impact Intellia Therapeutics' (NTLA) valuation and risk profile within the competitive transthyretin amyloidosis treatment market?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-09-29

**Research question**
How do the durable Phase 1 TTR reduction results and the rapid advancement of the Phase 3 MAGNITUDE trials for nexiguran ziclumeran (nex-z) impact Intellia Therapeutics' (NTLA) valuation and risk profile within the competitive transthyretin amyloidosis treatment market?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-09-29, keep nexiguran ziclumeran’s (nex-z’s) probability-adjusted contribution to Intellia Therapeutics’ base-case valuation unchanged. Durable serum TTR lowering after a single dose strengthens the biological case, and a 100-patient increase in management’s year-end MAGNITUDE recruitment target reduces concern about recruitment delays. Neither finding shows that patients live longer or avoid hospitalization—the outcomes that already distinguish approved ATTR cardiomyopathy treatments. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=Patients%20with%20hereditary%20ATTR%20amyloidosis%20with%20polyneuropathy%20%28ATTRv-PN%29%20are,reverse%2C%20disease%20progression.%20Strategic%20Priorities%20and%20Anticipated%202025%20Milestones) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of%20Intellia%20Therapeutics%2C,of%20its%20collaborations%20on%20its%20development%20programs%2C%20including%20its) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250904184318/https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of,projected%20enrollment%20timelines%20or%20its%20projected%20cash%20runway%3B%20its) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723074839/https://www.pharmacytimes.com/view/fda-approves-vutrisiran-to-reduce-cardiovascular-death-hospitalizations-in-patients-with-attr-cm#:~:text=Updated%20on%20Friday%2C%20March%2021%2C%202025%2C%20at%2011%3A13%20AM.,Society%20of%20Cardiology%20Congress.3%20Image%20credit%3A%20ckybe%20%7C%20stock.adobe.com)

## Evidence

The Phase 3 update warrants more confidence in trial execution, not an earlier readout or a higher probability of efficacy. In August, Intellia said MAGNITUDE recruitment for cardiomyopathy was ahead of projections; its year-end target moved from at least 550 patients to at least 650. Neither figure is an actual enrollment count. Management expected expansion to strengthen the evidence for patients on stabilizers without changing the enrollment timeline. The separate MAGNITUDE-2 polyneuropathy trial had a projected enrollment finish in the first half of 2026, not a completed milestone. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=August%2007%2C%202025%2007%3A30%20ET%20%7C%20Source%3A%20Intellia%20Therapeutics%2C,Therapeutics%20Reports%20Inducement%20Grants%20under%20Nasdaq%20Listing%20Rule%205635%28c%29%284%29) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of%20Intellia%20Therapeutics%2C,of%20its%20collaborations%20on%20its%20development%20programs%2C%20including%20its) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250904184318/https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of,projected%20enrollment%20timelines%20or%20its%20projected%20cash%20runway%3B%20its)

A single dose could differentiate nex-z on convenience, but does not yet justify a market-share premium. Vutrisiran requires 4 subcutaneous doses per year and gained an ATTR-CM indication for reducing cardiovascular mortality, cardiovascular hospitalizations and urgent heart failure visits. Tafamidis also reduced cardiovascular death and hospitalization in a clinical trial. These outcomes establish a benchmark for adoption; they do not provide a head-to-head comparison or show that patients and payers would prefer nex-z. [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723074839/https://www.pharmacytimes.com/view/fda-approves-vutrisiran-to-reduce-cardiovascular-death-hospitalizations-in-patients-with-attr-cm#:~:text=ATTR-CM%20is%20a%20rapidly%20progressive%E2%80%94and%20ultimately%20fatal%E2%80%94disease%20estimated%20to,amyloidosis%20so%20they%20can%20live%20longer%2C%20better%2C%20healthier%20lives.%E2%80%9D1) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250723074839/https://www.pharmacytimes.com/view/fda-approves-vutrisiran-to-reduce-cardiovascular-death-hospitalizations-in-patients-with-attr-cm#:~:text=Updated%20on%20Friday%2C%20March%2021%2C%202025%2C%20at%2011%3A13%20AM.,Society%20of%20Cardiology%20Congress.3%20Image%20credit%3A%20ckybe%20%7C%20stock.adobe.com) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250620033940/https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/drug-trial-snapshots-vyndaqelvyndamax#:~:text=In%20a%20clinical%20trial%2C%20VYNDAMAX%20reduced%20the%20risk%20of,Method%20of%20All%E2%80%91Cause%20Mortality%20and%20Frequency%20of%20Cardiovascular%E2%80%91Related%20Hospitalizations)

## Outlook

Retain financing and dilution risk in NTLA’s equity valuation. Intellia discontinued an earlier program and announced a net workforce reduction of approximately 27% to concentrate resources on nex-z and its other late-stage program. That prioritization can protect trial execution. But management’s expectation that expansion would not shorten projected cash runway is narrower than a claim that Intellia is funded through pivotal results or launch. The disclosures here do not quantify a funding gap or prospective dilution. [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=Strategic%20Reorganization%20Focused%20on%20Key%20Value%20Drivers%3A%20The%20pipeline,to%20be%20incurred%20in%20the%20first%20quarter%20of%202025.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250904184318/https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of,projected%20enrollment%20timelines%20or%20its%20projected%20cash%20runway%3B%20its)

## What would change the view

The strongest upside case is that sustained suppression after a single treatment slows clinical decline without an offsetting long-term safety cost. The first test is the longer-term Phase 1 update management planned for the second half of 2025. Quantified follow-up showing preserved function alongside acceptable safety would justify a modest reassessment; another biomarker-only update would not. Reserve a material valuation increase for convincing pivotal evidence of patient benefit with acceptable safety. A material safety signal or weak clinical outcomes would instead warrant a reduction. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250904184318/https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of,projected%20enrollment%20timelines%20or%20its%20projected%20cash%20runway%3B%20its) [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20250721235859/https://www.hcplive.com/view/fda-approves-vutrisiran-amvuttra-for-attr-cm#:~:text=The%20US%20Food%20and%20Drug%20Administration%20%28FDA%29%20has%20approved,both%20cardiovascular%20outcomes%20and%20multiple%20measures%20of%20disease%20progression.%E2%80%9D)

## Checked calculations

- C1. Increase in management’s year-end 2025 MAGNITUDE enrollment target, not actual enrollment (patients) — 650 − 550 = 100 [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250904184318/https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial#:~:text=Forward-Looking%20Statements%20This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of,projected%20enrollment%20timelines%20or%20its%20projected%20cash%20runway%3B%20its) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908110154/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007346/0/en/Intellia-Therapeutics-Announces-Anticipated-2025-Milestones-and-Strategic-Reorganization-to-Prioritize-the-Advancement-of-its-Late-Stage-Programs-NTLA-2002-and-Nexiguran-Ziclumeran.html#:~:text=This%20press%20release%20contains%20%E2%80%9Cforward-looking%20statements%E2%80%9D%20of%20Intellia%20Therapeutics%2C,of%20its%20collaborations%20on%20its%20development%20programs%2C%20including%20its)

question: How will the transition from Secretary Raimondo’s semiconductor-focused industrial strategy to President Trump’s trade deficit probes and tariff-heavy agenda impact the operational stability and capital expenditure plans of U.S. technology firms currently relying on CHIPS Act funding and export control frameworks?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-01-27

**Research question**
How will the transition from Secretary Raimondo’s semiconductor-focused industrial strategy to President Trump’s trade deficit probes and tariff-heavy agenda impact the operational stability and capital expenditure plans of U.S. technology firms currently relying on CHIPS Act funding and export control frameworks?

## Answer

As of 2025-01-27, Intel should maintain work covered by its $7.86 billion U.S. manufacturing award. Micron should phase spending: keep Boise construction moving and fund the work needed for Clay’s next grant milestone, but tie later capacity commitments to customer orders and financing. Neither company should defer its U.S. program merely because trade policy is shifting. The enacted controls restrict China-bound shipments; the available evidence shows neither a blocked delivery to a U.S. fab nor an interruption of CHIPS payments. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1269637014) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=Senate%20Majority%20Leader%20Charles%20Schumer%2C%20D-N.Y.%2C%20said%20the%20funding,Micron%E2%80%99s%20headquarters%20in%20Boise%2C%20Idaho%2C%20where%20construction%20has%20started.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=The%20Commerce%20Department%20said%20Micron%20will%20have%20to%20meet,and%20%241.5%20billion%20in%20grants%20for%20the%20Boise%20expansion.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127175804/https://www.csis.org/analysis/understanding-biden-administrations-updated-export-controls#:~:text=The%20SME%20FDPR%20is%20primarily%20focused%20on%20ensuring%20that,U.S.%20content%20to%20be%20subject%20to%20U.S.%20export%20controls.)

## Evidence

Intel’s award is more durable than an announced allocation target, but finalization is not cash receipt. Reports that most awards were still pending in mid-November predate Intel’s final agreement later that month for Arizona, New Mexico, Ohio and Oregon. That sequence argues for preserving the agreed work schedule, not accelerating purchases on the assumption that the entire award is available. The evidence does not establish Intel’s next payment date, conditions or cash received. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1269637014)

Micron’s final agreement secures eligibility for up to $4.6 billion for Clay and $1.5 billion for Boise, not unconditional payment. A blanket pause could delay the very work that releases the grants. Conversely, the milestones were not disclosed and Micron declined the federal loans, so later construction should proceed only if Micron can fund the interval before payment. For Manassas, defer any commitment that depends on the proposed $275 million grant: unlike the Clay and Boise awards, that agreement is nonbinding. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=The%20Commerce%20Department%20said%20Micron%20will%20have%20to%20meet,and%20%241.5%20billion%20in%20grants%20for%20the%20Boise%20expansion.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=The%20milestones%20that%20Micron%20must%20meet%20and%20other%20details,the%20federal%20loans%20as%20part%20of%20the%20final%20deal.) [6](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=The%20White%20House%20also%20announced%20a%20previously%20undisclosed%20deal,like%20the%20funding%20for%20Central%20New%20York%20and%20Idaho.)

For equipment access, destination matters more than the supplier’s nationality. The expanded foreign direct product rules reach covered advanced tools across China and a broader equipment list at designated Chinese fabs; the reported Dutch and Japanese exemption concerns the expanded rule, not unrestricted access to all tools. A supplier can lose a Chinese sale without losing the ability to install that tool in Ohio or Idaho. Before changing a construction schedule, obtain vendor confirmation of delivery and service dates for tools on the project’s critical path. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127175804/https://www.csis.org/analysis/understanding-biden-administrations-updated-export-controls#:~:text=The%20SME%20FDPR%20is%20primarily%20focused%20on%20ensuring%20that,U.S.%20content%20to%20be%20subject%20to%20U.S.%20export%20controls.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250107123823/https://www.reuters.com/technology/latest-us-strike-chinas-chips-hits-semiconductor-toolmakers-2024-12-02/#:~:text=Netherlands%2C%20Japan%20exempted%20from%20expanded%20foreign%20direct%20product%20rule,bandwidth%20memory%20shipped%20to%20China%20DUTCH%20AND%20JAPANESE%20EXEMPTED)

Export revenue is a more direct risk for Micron than U.S. tool availability: restrictions on high-bandwidth memory shipped to China narrow the set of customers Micron can serve. That does not establish that its planned U.S. output will go unsold. Nvidia’s reported Singapore revenue and its China investigation are not measures of either Micron’s lost orders or Intel’s export exposure. Without company-specific orders, licensing outcomes and replacement demand, the evidence cannot establish a revenue loss large enough to idle either firm’s planned capacity. [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250107123823/https://www.reuters.com/technology/latest-us-strike-chinas-chips-hits-semiconductor-toolmakers-2024-12-02/#:~:text=Netherlands%2C%20Japan%20exempted%20from%20expanded%20foreign%20direct%20product%20rule,bandwidth%20memory%20shipped%20to%20China%20DUTCH%20AND%20JAPANESE%20EXEMPTED) [8](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127175804/https://www.csis.org/analysis/understanding-biden-administrations-updated-export-controls#:~:text=Of%20note%2C%20Nvidia%E2%80%99s%20reported%20revenue%20from%20Singapore%20exploded%20in,real%20risk%20of%20a%20strong%20domestic%20Chinese%20HBM%20champion.)

## Outlook

Treat Trump’s trade-deficit probes as a reason to test scenarios, not as a current tariff bill. Even Raimondo had discussed possible tariffs aimed at Chinese legacy chips; a duty on competing finished chips could support domestic pricing, whereas a duty on imported fab tools could raise the cost of adding U.S. capacity. Keep proposed duties out of the base budget. Reprice uncommitted orders only against an effective measure’s product coverage, origin rules and delivery dates; the available tariff discussion establishes none of those for the proposed measures. [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127175804/https://www.csis.org/analysis/understanding-biden-administrations-updated-export-controls#:~:text=Some%20of%20this%20is%20supported%20by%20the%20language%20in,controls%20titled%2C%20%E2%80%9CExport%20Control%20Framework%20for%20Artificial%20Intelligence%20Diffusion.%E2%80%9D)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside case is a cash shortfall before the next fab milestone: export orders fall or tool costs rise while the company must still pay contractors before receiving its grant. Test the base case at each spending decision against firm customer orders, binding tool quotes and actual grant receipts. Defer the affected expansion if a confirmed delivery delay blocks installation, lost orders leave the added capacity without buyers, or a delayed payment leaves the next construction phase unfunded. A probe announcement alone meets none of those tests. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=The%20Commerce%20Department%20said%20Micron%20will%20have%20to%20meet,and%20%241.5%20billion%20in%20grants%20for%20the%20Boise%20expansion.) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20250107123823/https://www.reuters.com/technology/latest-us-strike-chinas-chips-hits-semiconductor-toolmakers-2024-12-02/#:~:text=Netherlands%2C%20Japan%20exempted%20from%20expanded%20foreign%20direct%20product%20rule,bandwidth%20memory%20shipped%20to%20China%20DUTCH%20AND%20JAPANESE%20EXEMPTED) [9](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127175804/https://www.csis.org/analysis/understanding-biden-administrations-updated-export-controls#:~:text=Some%20of%20this%20is%20supported%20by%20the%20language%20in,controls%20titled%2C%20%E2%80%9CExport%20Control%20Framework%20for%20Artificial%20Intelligence%20Diffusion.%E2%80%9D)

## Sources

1. [CHIPS and Science Act](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1269637014), available by 2025-01-15.
2. [Micron signs historic deal with feds for $6.1 billion to build chip plants in Central NY, Idaho - syracuse.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20250127234637/https://www.syracuse.com/business/2024/12/micron-signs-historic-deal-with-feds-for-61-billion-to-build-chip-plants-in-central-ny-idaho.html#:~:text=Senate%20Majority%20Leader%20Charles%20Schumer%2C%20D-N.Y.%2C%20said%20the%20funding,Micron%E2%80%99s%20headquarters%20in%20Boise%2C%20Idaho%2C%20where%20construction%20has%20started.), available by 2025-01-27.

question: How should institutional investors interpret the recent volatility in U.S. rail traffic data reported by the AAR in October 2025, and does the 1.2% decline for the week ending October 11 signal a broader macro-economic slowdown impacting Class I railroad profitability?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-10-22

**Research question**
How should institutional investors interpret the recent volatility in U.S. rail traffic data reported by the AAR in October 2025, and does the 1.2% decline for the week ending October 11 signal a broader macro-economic slowdown impacting Class I railroad profitability?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Evidence

The clearest observed weakness is in import containers, not freight generally. September imports at Los Angeles and Long Beach fell 7.3% year over year. That is consistent with fewer international containers being available for inland rail shipment. It does not measure the share that moved by rail, domestic intermodal loads or commodity carloads. Nor did all cargo at each port fall at the combined import rate: total container volume fell 3.9% at Long Beach and 7.5% at Los Angeles. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20251021051231/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/trade/exports/insights/container-imports-to-busiest-us-port-complex-fell-7-in-september/articleshow/124655679.cms#:~:text=Container%20imports%20to%20busiest%20US%20port%20complex%20fell%207%25,at%20the%20ET%20Make%20in%20India%20SME%20Regional%20Summit..) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251018001955/https://gcaptain.com/tariff-pressures-push-september-cargo-down-at-los-angeles-long-beach-port-complex/#:~:text=The%20Port%20of%20Long%20Beach%20moved%20797%2C537%20twenty-foot%20equivalent,coaster%20all%20year%20and%20that%20ride%20continues%2C%E2%80%9D%20Seroka%20said.)

## Outlook

The base case is that tariff deadlines shifted some holiday freight into earlier months. September's import decline can coexist with a record quarter for total container volume at Los Angeles and a near-record quarter at Long Beach. This explanation predicts that weakness will be most visible in port-linked intermodal traffic; it does not require an immediate rebound. The strongest alternative is that weaker final demand is now compounding the inventory adjustment. Continued declines in domestic intermodal and across industrial carloads, not just imported containers, would favor that interpretation. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20251018001955/https://gcaptain.com/tariff-pressures-push-september-cargo-down-at-los-angeles-long-beach-port-complex/#:~:text=The%20recent%20data%20aligns%20with%20broader%20industry%20forecasts.%20According,full%20inflationary%20impact%20of%20the%20tariffs%20will%20become%20apparent.%E2%80%9D) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20251018001955/https://gcaptain.com/tariff-pressures-push-september-cargo-down-at-los-angeles-long-beach-port-complex/#:~:text=Despite%20the%20September%20decline%2C%20both%20ports%20posted%20strong%20third-quarter,September%2C%203%25%20more%20than%20the%20same%20period%20last%20year.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20251021051231/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/trade/exports/insights/container-imports-to-busiest-us-port-complex-fell-7-in-september/articleshow/124655679.cms#:~:text=Container%20imports%20to%20busiest%20US%20port%20complex%20fell%207%25,at%20the%20ET%20Make%20in%20India%20SME%20Regional%20Summit..)

## What would change the view

Verify the series, geography and comparison period in the original AAR release, then track the same categories over subsequent weeks against both last year and carrier volume assumptions. Cut an individual carrier's estimate only if a persistent shortfall in the affected freight costs more in lost contribution than the carrier can recover through pricing on retained loads and additional crew or train-cost savings. Check that judgment against carrier disclosures on mix, realized rates and costs. Reduce sector exposure only if that earnings risk is material across carriers. The port data establish neither persistence in rail volumes nor the net profit effect. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20251002034940/https://railway-news.com/associations/association-of-american-railroads/#:~:text=As%20the%20standard%20setting%20organization%20for%20North%20America%E2%80%99s%20railroads%2C,catalog.%E2%80%8B%20425%203rd%20St%20SW%20Washington%20DC%2020024%20USA) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20251018001955/https://gcaptain.com/tariff-pressures-push-september-cargo-down-at-los-angeles-long-beach-port-complex/#:~:text=The%20Port%20of%20Long%20Beach%20moved%20797%2C537%20twenty-foot%20equivalent,coaster%20all%20year%20and%20that%20ride%20continues%2C%E2%80%9D%20Seroka%20said.)

question: Given the Institute for Supply Management's reports of a deceleration in services activity as of August 2025, how does the historical divergence between ISM and S&P Global Services PMI readings impact the assessment of US economic resilience and potential shifts in Federal Reserve monetary policy?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-05

**Research question**
Given the Institute for Supply Management's reports of a deceleration in services activity as of August 2025, how does the historical divergence between ISM and S&P Global Services PMI readings impact the assessment of US economic resilience and potential shifts in Federal Reserve monetary policy?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-08-05, retain a September Fed hold as the base case. The July services evidence does not justify downgrading US growth enough to favor a cut: S&P Global’s composite output index rose from 52.9 to 55.1, with services driving the acceleration. The stronger case for a cut comes from hiring, not output: July payrolls rose by only 73,000, and prior gains were revised down. Resilient activity and a weakening labor market can coexist. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250805134916/https://www.pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Home/PressRelease/3b4c09ac68ec4b03a5fcd98f1e0f3b98#:~:text=Activity%20Index.%20The%20weights%20reflect%20the%20relative%20size%20of,rose%20at%20a%20softer%20pace.%20The%20rate%20of%20growth) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803192925/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/us-treasury-yields-investors-await-key-jobs-report-.html#:~:text=The%202-year%20yield%20note%20yield%20plunged%20more%20than%2025,100%2C000.%20The%20unemployment%20rate%20increased%20to%204.2%25%2C%20as%20expected.)

## Evidence

The verified ISM contraction was in May, not June: its services PMI rose from 49.9 in May to 50.8 in June, back above the 50 breakeven mark. The available ISM notice schedules the July report but does not give its result. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722204438/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-50-8-june-2025-services-ism-report-on-business-302497305.html#:~:text=Business%20Activity%20Index%20at%2054.2%25%3B%20New%20Orders%20Index%20at,points%20lower%20than%20the%2050.7%20percent%20recorded%20in%20May.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722204438/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-50-8-june-2025-services-ism-report-on-business-302497305.html#:~:text=The%20next%20Services%20ISM%C2%AE%20Report%20On%20Business%C2%AE%20featuring%20July,2025.%20%2AUnless%20the%20New%20York%20Stock%20Exchange%20is%20closed.)

Index design can explain part of an apparent gap without implying that either survey misread output. In June, ISM’s own business activity index was 54.2 while employment was 47.2: the headline understated the strength of its activity reading. S&P’s cited July figure is a GDP-weighted manufacturing-and-services output composite, not its standalone services PMI. Neither comparing it with ISM’s headline nor comparing July with June isolates a survey-design effect. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722204438/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-50-8-june-2025-services-ism-report-on-business-302497305.html#:~:text=Business%20Activity%20Index%20at%2054.2%25%3B%20New%20Orders%20Index%20at,points%20lower%20than%20the%2050.7%20percent%20recorded%20in%20May.) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250805134916/https://www.pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Home/PressRelease/3b4c09ac68ec4b03a5fcd98f1e0f3b98#:~:text=Activity%20Index.%20The%20weights%20reflect%20the%20relative%20size%20of,rose%20at%20a%20softer%20pace.%20The%20rate%20of%20growth)

Past gaps cannot be attributed to design on this record. A test would pair ISM business activity with S&P services activity for the same months, then compare overlapping industries at common weights. A gap that shrinks would support the design explanation. A gap that persists and tracks independently measured output in industries covered differently would support a real difference in activity. That alternative matters: ISM reported June growth in retail trade but contraction in construction. The paired historical readings and sector benchmarks are missing. [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722204438/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-50-8-june-2025-services-ism-report-on-business-302497305.html#:~:text=%22Ten%20industries%20reported%20growth%20in%20June%2C%20the%20same%20number,Assistance%3B%20Professional%2C%20Scientific%20%26%20Technical%20Services%3B%20and%20Educational%20Services.)

## What would change the view

Favor a September cut if the next jobs report confirms weaker hiring and both surveys’ services activity measures turn down, especially if consumer inflation eases. That combination would suggest labor weakness is spreading to demand. For now, S&P firms still added staff, albeit modestly, and ISM respondents had flagged rising costs. The fall of more than 25 basis points in the Treasury two-year yield after the jobs report shows investors took the labor risk seriously; it is not a Fed commitment. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250805134916/https://www.pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Home/PressRelease/3b4c09ac68ec4b03a5fcd98f1e0f3b98#:~:text=Activity%20Index.%20The%20weights%20reflect%20the%20relative%20size%20of,rose%20at%20a%20softer%20pace.%20The%20rate%20of%20growth) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250722204438/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/services-pmi-at-50-8-june-2025-services-ism-report-on-business-302497305.html#:~:text=%22Ten%20industries%20reported%20growth%20in%20June%2C%20the%20same%20number,Assistance%3B%20Professional%2C%20Scientific%20%26%20Technical%20Services%3B%20and%20Educational%20Services.) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250803192925/https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/01/us-treasury-yields-investors-await-key-jobs-report-.html#:~:text=The%202-year%20yield%20note%20yield%20plunged%20more%20than%2025,100%2C000.%20The%20unemployment%20rate%20increased%20to%204.2%25%2C%20as%20expected.)

question: How will the narrowing interest rate differential between the US and Japan, driven by Christopher Waller’s advocacy for 25 basis point cuts and the Bank of Japan’s tightening cycle, affect USD/JPY volatility and institutional carry trade strategies through late 2025?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-08-05

**Research question**
How will the narrowing interest rate differential between the US and Japan, driven by Christopher Waller’s advocacy for 25 basis point cuts and the Bank of Japan’s tightening cycle, affect USD/JPY volatility and institutional carry trade strategies through late 2025?

## Answer

As of 2025-08-05, reduce unhedged long-USD/short-JPY carry through late 2025 rather than retain full size. For dollar exposure that must stay on, price yen calls expiring after the relevant policy meetings. Christopher Waller’s advocacy for quarter-point Fed cuts and continued Bank of Japan tightening are unverified question premises, not a confirmed joint policy path. The reason to trim is the mismatch in scale and timing: carry accrues gradually, while a single yen rally can erase the holding period’s income before an institution can exit. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20130603192607/http://www.economicshelp.org/dictionary/y/yen-carry-trade-unwind.html#:~:text=Because%20interest%20rates%20in%20Japan%20are%20very%20low.%20Japanese,falls%2C%20you%20could%20lose%20despite%20the%20interest%20rate%20difference.) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1303974595)

## Evidence

Japan’s exit from negative rates makes further tightening plausible, not scheduled. At that exit the BOJ raised short-term rates from minus 0.1% to 0-0.1% and identified a wage-price cycle consistent with its inflation target. It also abandoned yield curve control without committing to another hike. Those observations explain the regime change; they are not an August rate quote. On the US side, the FOMC sets the funds-rate target: an individual governor’s preference, even if confirmed, would not establish the timing or size of a committee move. [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724205709/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2024/03/japan-ends-negative-interest-rates-economy-monetary-policy/#:~:text=In%20a%207-2%20majority%20vote%2C%20Japan%E2%80%99s%20central%20bank%20decided,world%20to%20end%20a%20policy%20of%20negative%20interest%20rates.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724205709/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2024/03/japan-ends-negative-interest-rates-economy-monetary-policy/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CAccording%20to%20the%20initial%20press%20release%20by%20JTUC-RENGO%2C%20one,the%20external%20environment%2C%20rather%20than%20by%20aggressive%20monetary%20easing.) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724205709/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2024/03/japan-ends-negative-interest-rates-economy-monetary-policy/#:~:text=What%20is%20the%20neutral%20interest%20rate%20and%20why%20is,behind%20negative%20interest%20rates%20and%20examines%20the%20policy%E2%80%99s%20impact.) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1303974595)

## Outlook

Base case, conditional on gradual narrowing: carry available at rollover shrinks, but USD/JPY volatility need not rise persistently. Forwards reflect the two currencies’ term funding rates, not a forecast of spot. At a given spot rate, a smaller US yield advantage means a smaller forward discount on dollars and less room for spot USD/JPY to fall before a new long-dollar trade loses money. A cut or hike already reflected in those curves is not a second loss on an existing forward. Test this case by comparing meeting-implied rates before and after each decision: little repricing alongside orderly spot trading would favor a smaller carry allocation, not an outright yen bet. [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1293812372) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20130603192607/http://www.economicshelp.org/dictionary/y/yen-carry-trade-unwind.html#:~:text=Lower%20Interest%20rates%20in%20US%2C%20Europe%20and%20other%20countries,even%20more%2C%20causing%20a%20further%20rise%20in%20the%20Yen.)

The strongest adverse alternative is abrupt convergence: Fed guidance implies faster cuts or the BOJ signals earlier hikes than markets had priced. A downward repricing of the US–Japan short-rate spread accompanied by falling USD/JPY and rising near-term implied volatility would distinguish that shock from an anticipated move. As spot losses consume margin and higher volatility tightens risk limits, leveraged funds may have to sell dollars and buy yen to repay funding. Their purchases can accelerate the yen rally. Past unwinds support that mechanism, not a claim that positions are equally crowded today. [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1293812372) [7](https://web.archive.org/web/20130603192607/http://www.economicshelp.org/dictionary/y/yen-carry-trade-unwind.html#:~:text=Lower%20Interest%20rates%20in%20US%2C%20Europe%20and%20other%20countries,even%20more%2C%20causing%20a%20further%20rise%20in%20the%20Yen.)

## What would change the view

Choose size versus insurance using executable prices. Stress a pre-meeting yen jump against the desk’s collateral buffer; trim until the position can survive it without selling. On required exposure, buy a yen call (USD put) if its strike protects the loss budget and the premium leaves acceptable net carry; otherwise reduce further. A Fed path repriced higher relative to Japan’s, with stable spot volatility and ample margin, would favor retaining more unhedged carry. The available evidence supplies no cutoff forward curve, option premiums, current positioning or desk limits, so it cannot establish how much narrowing is priced, forecast a volatility level or justify a specific hedge ratio. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20130603192607/http://www.economicshelp.org/dictionary/y/yen-carry-trade-unwind.html#:~:text=Because%20interest%20rates%20in%20Japan%20are%20very%20low.%20Japanese,falls%2C%20you%20could%20lose%20despite%20the%20interest%20rate%20difference.) [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1293812372)

## Sources

1. [Effects of Yen Carry Trade Unwinding | Economics Help](https://web.archive.org/web/20130603192607/http://www.economicshelp.org/dictionary/y/yen-carry-trade-unwind.html#:~:text=Because%20interest%20rates%20in%20Japan%20are%20very%20low.%20Japanese,falls%2C%20you%20could%20lose%20despite%20the%20interest%20rate%20difference.), available by 2013-06-03.
2. [Federal Open Market Committee](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1303974595), available by 2025-08-03.
3. [Japan ends era of negative interest rates. Here’s why | World Economic Forum](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724205709/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2024/03/japan-ends-negative-interest-rates-economy-monetary-policy/#:~:text=In%20a%207-2%20majority%20vote%2C%20Japan%E2%80%99s%20central%20bank%20decided,world%20to%20end%20a%20policy%20of%20negative%20interest%20rates.), available by 2025-07-24.
4. [Japan ends era of negative interest rates. Here’s why | World Economic Forum](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724205709/https://www.weforum.org/stories/2024/03/japan-ends-negative-interest-rates-economy-monetary-policy/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CAccording%20to%20the%20initial%20press%20release%20by%20JTUC-RENGO%2C%20one,the%20external%20environment%2C%20rather%20than%20by%20aggressive%20monetary%20easing.), available by 2025-07-24.

question: How has the acquisition of NFP impacted Aon PLC's capital structure and operating efficiency, and to what extent are realized synergies offsetting the increased debt servicing costs and higher operating expenses identified in early 2025 earnings reports?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-23

**Research question**
How has the acquisition of NFP impacted Aon PLC's capital structure and operating efficiency, and to what extent are realized synergies offsetting the increased debt servicing costs and higher operating expenses identified in early 2025 earnings reports?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-04-23, Aon had not demonstrated that recurring savings from its $13.0 billion NFP acquisition covered incremental interest and operating costs. The latest reported period was the fourth quarter and full year 2024. Aon realized $40 million of restructuring savings in the quarter, but did not identify the recurring NFP share. Coverage was therefore unproven, not necessarily negative: neither a shortfall nor a surplus can be quantified. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241101211941/https://www.nfp.com/about-nfp/newsroom/nfp-acquired-as-independent-and-connected-aon-company/#:~:text=Enterprise%20value%20of%20%2413.0%20billion%2C%20including%20%247.0%20billion%20cash,United%20strategy%20and%20further%20enhance%20our%20relevance%20to%20clients.%22) [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter%20increased%2023%25%20to,decrease%20in%20adjusted%20operating%20income%2C%20for%20full%20year%202025.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%202024%20increased%2017%25%20to%20%2415.7%20billion,billion%20of%20remaining%20authorization%20under%20its%20share%20repurchase%20program.)

## Evidence

Aon financed the deal with a mix of shares, cash and assumed liabilities. At the April 25, 2024 close, sellers received 19.0 million Aon shares valued at $6.0 billion, spreading future earnings across a larger shareholder base. The other $7.0 billion combined cash and assumed liabilities; it was not a measure of new borrowing. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20241101211941/https://www.nfp.com/about-nfp/newsroom/nfp-acquired-as-independent-and-connected-aon-company/#:~:text=Enterprise%20value%20of%20%2413.0%20billion%2C%20including%20%247.0%20billion%20cash,United%20strategy%20and%20further%20enhance%20our%20relevance%20to%20clients.%22)

Consolidated operating efficiency improved in the fourth quarter: revenue grew 23% to $4.1 billion, faster than operating expenses grew (18% to $3.1 billion). That supports a higher operating margin, not a finding that NFP savings paid for NFP costs. Revenue included acquired business and organic growth. Expenses included NFP’s ongoing costs, acquisition-related amortization and growth investment; a prior-year settlement charge also made the comparison more favorable. Aon did not isolate NFP’s incremental recurring expense in dollars. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter%20increased%2023%25%20to,decrease%20in%20adjusted%20operating%20income%2C%20for%20full%20year%202025.)

## What would change the view

The base case is a partial offset at the group level, with no assumption of deal-level break-even. The strongest alternative is that recurring NFP efficiencies already covered the added costs but were not separately reported. The earlier close brought expected accretion and cash-flow benefits forward; that was a forecast, not a realized savings figure, and acquired earnings can drive accretion without cost savings. The decisive signal would be a same-period reconciliation comparing realized, recurring NFP savings with deal-related interest and incremental ongoing operating costs before those savings, excluding one-time charges and avoiding double counting. [2](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter%20increased%2023%25%20to,decrease%20in%20adjusted%20operating%20income%2C%20for%20full%20year%202025.) [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20241101211941/https://www.nfp.com/about-nfp/newsroom/nfp-acquired-as-independent-and-connected-aon-company/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CWith%20Aon%E2%80%99s%20acquisition%20of%20NFP%20now%20complete%2C%20we%20are,acted%20as%20external%20legal%20counsel%20to%20NFP%E2%80%99s%20capital%20sponsors.)

## Sources

1. [NFP acquired as independent and connected Aon company | NFP](https://web.archive.org/web/20241101211941/https://www.nfp.com/about-nfp/newsroom/nfp-acquired-as-independent-and-connected-aon-company/#:~:text=Enterprise%20value%20of%20%2413.0%20billion%2C%20including%20%247.0%20billion%20cash,United%20strategy%20and%20further%20enhance%20our%20relevance%20to%20clients.%22), available by 2024-11-01.
2. [Aon Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%20the%20fourth%20quarter%20increased%2023%25%20to,decrease%20in%20adjusted%20operating%20income%2C%20for%20full%20year%202025.), available by 2025-01-31.
3. [Aon Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results](https://web.archive.org/web/20250131205627/https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/aon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results-302364989.html#:~:text=Total%20revenue%20in%202024%20increased%2017%25%20to%20%2415.7%20billion,billion%20of%20remaining%20authorization%20under%20its%20share%20repurchase%20program.), available by 2025-01-31.
4. [NFP acquired as independent and connected Aon company | NFP](https://web.archive.org/web/20241101211941/https://www.nfp.com/about-nfp/newsroom/nfp-acquired-as-independent-and-connected-aon-company/#:~:text=%E2%80%9CWith%20Aon%E2%80%99s%20acquisition%20of%20NFP%20now%20complete%2C%20we%20are,acted%20as%20external%20legal%20counsel%20to%20NFP%E2%80%99s%20capital%20sponsors.), available by 2024-11-01.

question: How do the ongoing legal disputes over corporate governance and Jerry Greenfield's buyback negotiations impact the valuation and execution risk of Unilever’s planned 2025 spin-off of its multi-billion dollar ice cream division?
report:
# Investment research memo

As of 2025-04-28

**Research question**
How do the ongoing legal disputes over corporate governance and Jerry Greenfield's buyback negotiations impact the valuation and execution risk of Unilever’s planned 2025 spin-off of its multi-billion dollar ice cream division?

Some parts of the question could not be established from eligible evidence.

## Answer

As of 2025-04-28, I would neither discount the expected equity value of Unilever’s ice cream spin-off nor lower the probability of 2025 completion on the Ben & Jerry’s evidence alone. The dispute concerns one brand in a portfolio that also includes Magnum and Cornetto. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250420153123/https://www.thisismoney.co.uk/money/markets/article-14564827/Founder-plot-buy-woke-Ben-Jerrys-derail-Unilevers-ice-cream-demerger.html#:~:text=The%20co-founder%20of%20Ben%20%26%20Jerry%E2%80%99s%20has%20launched%20a,set%20up%20with%20his%20friend%20Jerry%20Greenfield%20in%201978.) [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1283778239) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250424064539/https://www.unilever.com/news/press-and-media/press-releases/2025/resilient-performance-full-year-outlook-reconfirmed/#:~:text=We%20are%20on%20track%20to%20complete%20the%20separation%20of,important%20step%20to%20ensure%20maximum%20category%20focus%20and%20accountability.)

## Evidence

Founder interest is credible; a formal Greenfield offer is not verified. Fortune describes discussions by the founders. The more specific report calls the effort a “bid” but describes Cohen trying to assemble investors. Neither account supplies a submitted proposal, price, committed financing or confirmation of negotiations with Unilever. That distinction matters for valuation: a buyback discussion is neither a price benchmark for Ben & Jerry’s nor a reason to remove its earnings from the spin-off forecast. [4](https://web.archive.org/web/20250413083820/https://fortune.com/2025/02/27/ben-jerrys-ice-cream-unilever-demerger/#:~:text=Ben%20%26%20Jerry%E2%80%99s%20founders%20discuss%20buying%20back%20ice%20cream%20brand) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250420153123/https://www.thisismoney.co.uk/money/markets/article-14564827/Founder-plot-buy-woke-Ben-Jerrys-derail-Unilevers-ice-cream-demerger.html#:~:text=The%20co-founder%20of%20Ben%20%26%20Jerry%E2%80%99s%20has%20launched%20a,set%20up%20with%20his%20friend%20Jerry%20Greenfield%20in%201978.)

The board’s brand protections create a route to litigation, not a demonstrated veto. Ben & Jerry’s previously sued to block a sale of its Israeli business on brand-integrity grounds. The current dispute concerns alleged limits on social advocacy and alleged retaliation against its chief executive. The docket records the company and independent directors seeking leave to amend their complaint; that is not a ruling. The excerpts establish neither a contractual consent right covering the division-wide demerger nor a court order restraining it. They also cannot rule out a future challenge. [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1283778239) [5](https://web.archive.org/web/20250319200648/https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/69373819/ben-jerrys-homemade-inc-v-unilever-plc/#:~:text=Set%2FReset%20Deadlines%3A%20Motions%20due%20by%203%2F19%2F2025.%20Responses%20due%20by,Proposed%202nd%20Amended%20Complaint%20%28Clean%20Copy%29%29.%28Halepota%2C%20Shahmeer%29%20%28Entered%3A%2003%2F18%2F2025%29)

## Outlook

The testable base case is that The Magnum Ice Cream Company retains Ben & Jerry’s and completes the demerger in the fourth quarter of 2025. Unilever’s 24 April update postdates the press warning of derailment and provides checkpoints: expected standalone operations from 1 July and a capital markets day on 9 September before listing in Amsterdam, London and New York. Standalone operations would demonstrate readiness, not legal completion. A missed milestone or revised guidance would carry more weight for timing than the buyback headline. [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1283778239) [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250420153123/https://www.thisismoney.co.uk/money/markets/article-14564827/Founder-plot-buy-woke-Ben-Jerrys-derail-Unilevers-ice-cream-demerger.html#:~:text=The%20co-founder%20of%20Ben%20%26%20Jerry%E2%80%99s%20has%20launched%20a,set%20up%20with%20his%20friend%20Jerry%20Greenfield%20in%201978.) [3](https://web.archive.org/web/20250424064539/https://www.unilever.com/news/press-and-media/press-releases/2025/resilient-performance-full-year-outlook-reconfirmed/#:~:text=We%20are%20on%20track%20to%20complete%20the%20separation%20of,important%20step%20to%20ensure%20maximum%20category%20focus%20and%20accountability.)

## What would change the view

The strongest downside case is that a funded proposal Unilever takes up, or a court order tied to the transfer of Ben & Jerry’s, forces Unilever to redraw the separation plan. Either would warrant reassessing timing. For equity value, the test is different: compare the earnings lost and additional stand-alone costs with any sale proceeds retained by the spun-off company. A sale need not destroy value, while a governance dispute could impair brand earnings even without delaying the listing. The record provides no offer terms, brand profit figures or quantified litigation costs from which to size a discount. [1](https://web.archive.org/web/20250420153123/https://www.thisismoney.co.uk/money/markets/article-14564827/Founder-plot-buy-woke-Ben-Jerrys-derail-Unilevers-ice-cream-demerger.html#:~:text=The%20co-founder%20of%20Ben%20%26%20Jerry%E2%80%99s%20has%20launched%20a,set%20up%20with%20his%20friend%20Jerry%20Greenfield%20in%201978.)
